<sub>108m 8s</sub>

### Reasoning

*I'm working out the design: when animations are disabled or reduced motion is set, the network gets drawn as one static frame, and when they're on it runs at 30fps and pauses while the page is hidden. For theme changes, I'm wondering whether a static drawing should redraw too, so I'm planning to read colors from the CSS variables and watch the data-theme and style attributes on the root element with a MutationObserver, since theme overrides probably set inline styles there.

I'm confirming the MutationObserver on the style and data-theme attributes is fine, then switching the resize handling to a ResizeObserver on the canvas so the width and height get cached instead of reading offsetWidth every frame. For the edges, I'm planning to bucket opacity into about eight levels and build one path per bucket, then write it.

I'm caching the background's colors and size, drawing a single static frame when animations or reduced motion are on, and otherwise running at 30 fps, paused while the tab is hidden.*

import React, { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';

import { useBackgroundAnimations } from '../../utils/backgroundAnimations.js';

const NODE_COUNT = 65;
const CONNECTION_DIST = 160;
const CONNECTION_DIST_SQ = CONNECTION_DIST * CONNECTION_DIST;
const NODE_MIN_R = 1.2;
const NODE_MAX_R = 2.8;
const SPEED_FACTOR = 0.18;
const FRAME_INTERVAL_MS = 1000 / 30;
const ALPHA_BUCKETS = 8;
const TWO_PI = Math.PI * 2;

function readColors() {
  const styles = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement);
  const read = (name, fallback) => styles.getPropertyValue(name).trim() || fallback;
  return {
    node: read('--network-node-color', 'rgba(252, 198, 118, 0.55)'),
    edge: read('--network-edge-color', 'rgba(174, 135, 79, 0.12)'),
    glow: read('--network-glow-color', 'rgba(252, 198, 118, 0.08)'),
  };
}

function usePrefersReducedMotion() {
  const [reduced, setReduced] = React.useState(
    () => typeof window !== 'undefined' && !!window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches
  );
  useEffect(() => {
    const query = window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
    if (!query) return undefined;
    const onChange = (event) => setReduced(event.matches);
    query.addEventListener('change', onChange);
    return () => query.removeEventListener('change', onChange);
  }, []);
  return reduced;
}

/**
 * NetworkBackground — node & edge graph behind the workspace.
 * Colors come from CSS variables so the Theme Studio can control them.
 * Animates only when background animations are enabled, motion is allowed
 * and the tab is visible; otherwise a single static frame is drawn.
 */
export default function NetworkBackground() {
  const canvasRef = useRef(null);
  const { areBackgroundAnimationsEnabled } = useBackgroundAnimations();
  const prefersReducedMotion = usePrefersReducedMotion();
  const shouldAnimate = areBackgroundAnimationsEnabled && !prefersReducedMotion;

  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return undefined;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

    let width = canvas.offsetWidth;
    let height = canvas.offsetHeight;
    let colors = readColors();
    let frameId = null;
    let lastFrameTime = 0;
    const buckets = Array.from({ length: ALPHA_BUCKETS }, () => []);

    const nodes = Array.from({ length: NODE_COUNT }, () => ({
      x: Math.random() * width,
      y: Math.random() * height,
      vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * SPEED_FACTOR,
      vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * SPEED_FACTOR,
      r: NODE_MIN_R + Math.random() * (NODE_MAX_R - NODE_MIN_R),
      pulse: Math.random() * TWO_PI,
      pulseSpeed: 0.008 + Math.random() * 0.012,
    }));

    const step = (delta) => {
      for (const node of nodes) {
        node.x += node.vx * delta;
        node.y += node.vy * delta;
        node.pulse += node.pulseSpeed * delta;
        if (node.x < 0 || node.x > width) node.vx *= -1;
        if (node.y < 0 || node.y > height) node.vy *= -1;
        node.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width, node.x));
        node.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(height, node.y));
      }
    };

    const render = () => {
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);

      for (const bucket of buckets) bucket.length = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < NODE_COUNT; i++) {
        const a = nodes[i];
        for (let j = i + 1; j < NODE_COUNT; j++) {
          const b = nodes[j];
          const dx = a.x - b.x;
          const dy = a.y - b.y;
          const distSq = dx * dx + dy * dy;
          if (distSq < CONNECTION_DIST_SQ) {
            const opacity = 1 - Math.sqrt(distSq) / CONNECTION_DIST;
            const index = Math.min(ALPHA_BUCKETS - 1, Math.floor(opacity * ALPHA_BUCKETS));
            buckets[index].push(a.x, a.y, b.x, b.y);
          }
        }
      }

      ctx.lineWidth = 0.6;
      ctx.strokeStyle = colors.edge;
      for (let k = 0; k < ALPHA_BUCKETS; k++) {
        const segments = buckets[k];
        if (segments.length === 0) continue;
        ctx.globalAlpha = (k + 0.5) / ALPHA_BUCKETS;
        ctx.beginPath();
        for (let s = 0; s < segments.length; s += 4) {
          ctx.moveTo(segments[s], segments[s + 1]);
          ctx.lineTo(segments[s + 2], segments[s + 3]);
        }
        ctx.stroke();
      }

      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      ctx.fillStyle = colors.glow;
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (const node of nodes) {
        const r = node.r * (1 + 0.25 * Math.sin(node.pulse)) * 3;
        ctx.moveTo(node.x + r, node.y);
        ctx.arc(node.x, node.y, r, 0, TWO_PI);
      }
      ctx.fill();

      ctx.fillStyle = colors.node;
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (const node of nodes) {
        const r = node.r * (1 + 0.25 * Math.sin(node.pulse));
        ctx.moveTo(node.x + r, node.y);
        ctx.arc(node.x, node.y, r, 0, TWO_PI);
      }
      ctx.fill();
    };

    const stop = () => {
      if (frameId !== null) cancelAnimationFrame(frameId);
      frameId = null;
    };

    const tick = (time) => {
      frameId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      const elapsed = time - lastFrameTime;
      if (elapsed < FRAME_INTERVAL_MS) return;
      // Normalize to the original 60fps tuning; clamp to avoid jumps after stalls.
      step(Math.min(elapsed, 100) / (1000 / 60));
      lastFrameTime = time;
      render();
    };

    const start = () => {
      if (!shouldAnimate || document.hidden || frameId !== null) return;
      lastFrameTime = performance.now();
      frameId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    };

    const resize = () => {
      const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
      width = canvas.offsetWidth;
      height = canvas.offsetHeight;
      canvas.width = Math.round(width * dpr);
      canvas.height = Math.round(height * dpr);
      ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
      for (const node of nodes) {
        if (node.x > width) node.x = Math.random() * width;
        if (node.y > height) node.y = Math.random() * height;
      }
      render();
    };

    const handleVisibility = () => (document.hidden ? stop() : start());

    const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(resize);
    resizeObserver.observe(canvas);

    // Theme switches / Theme Studio overrides change CSS vars on <html>.
    const themeObserver = new MutationObserver(() => {
      colors = readColors();
      if (frameId === null) render();
    });
    themeObserver.observe(document.documentElement, {
      attributes: true,
      attributeFilter: ['style', 'data-theme', 'class'],
    });

    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibility);
    resize();
    start();

    return () => {
      stop();
      resizeObserver.disconnect();
      themeObserver.disconnect();
      document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibility);
    };
  }, [shouldAnimate]);

  return <canvas ref={canvasRef} className="workspace_network_bg" aria-hidden="true" />;
}

import React, { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';

import WorkspaceWindowBody from './WorkspaceWindowBody.jsx';

const DRAG_START_OFFSET = {
  x: 22,
  y: 74,
};

const WINDOW_STAGGER = {
  x: 30,
  y: 24,
};

const DEFAULT_WINDOW_SIZE = {
  width: 1179,
  height: 823,
};

const WINDOW_SIZE_LIMITS = {
  minWidth: 640,
  minHeight: 420,
  maxWidth: 1800,
  maxHeight: 1200,
};

const RESIZE_DIRECTIONS = {
  LEFT: 'left',
  RIGHT: 'right',
  BOTTOM: 'bottom',
  BOTTOM_LEFT: 'bottom-left',
  BOTTOM_RIGHT: 'bottom-right',
};

const RESIZE_HANDLES = [
  { direction: RESIZE_DIRECTIONS.LEFT, className: 'is-left' },
  { direction: RESIZE_DIRECTIONS.RIGHT, className: 'is-right' },
  { direction: RESIZE_DIRECTIONS.BOTTOM, className: 'is-bottom' },
  { direction: RESIZE_DIRECTIONS.BOTTOM_LEFT, className: 'is-bottom-left' },
  { direction: RESIZE_DIRECTIONS.BOTTOM_RIGHT, className: 'is-bottom-right' },
];

const clamp = (value, min, max) => Math.min(Math.max(value, min), max);

const getInitialWindowPosition = (windowItem, stackIndex) => {
  const storedPosition = windowItem?.metadata?.windowPosition;
  const storedX = Number(storedPosition?.x);
  const storedY = Number(storedPosition?.y);

  if (Number.isFinite(storedX) && Number.isFinite(storedY)) {
    return { x: storedX, y: storedY };
  }

  return {
    x: DRAG_START_OFFSET.x + stackIndex * WINDOW_STAGGER.x,
    y: DRAG_START_OFFSET.y + stackIndex * WINDOW_STAGGER.y,
  };
};

const getInitialWindowSize = (windowItem, parentSize = {}) => {
  const storedSize = windowItem?.metadata?.windowSize || {};
  const storedWidth = Number(storedSize?.width);
  const storedHeight = Number(storedSize?.height);
  const parentWidth = Number(parentSize.width) || 0;
  const parentHeight = Number(parentSize.height) || 0;
  const maxWidth = parentWidth > 0 ? Math.min(WINDOW_SIZE_LIMITS.maxWidth, Math.max(parentWidth - 44, WINDOW_SIZE_LIMITS.minWidth)) : WINDOW_SIZE_LIMITS.maxWidth;
  const maxHeight = parentHeight > 0 ? Math.min(WINDOW_SIZE_LIMITS.maxHeight, Math.max(parentHeight - 96, WINDOW_SIZE_LIMITS.minHeight)) : WINDOW_SIZE_LIMITS.maxHeight;

  return {
    width: clamp(Number.isFinite(storedWidth) ? storedWidth : DEFAULT_WINDOW_SIZE.width, WINDOW_SIZE_LIMITS.minWidth, maxWidth),
    height: clamp(Number.isFinite(storedHeight) ? storedHeight : DEFAULT_WINDOW_SIZE.height, WINDOW_SIZE_LIMITS.minHeight, maxHeight),
  };
};

  const windowRef = useRef(null);

  // Expanded right panel  → allow overflow into .workspace_work_area (panel is fully visible underneath)
  const getBoundsElement = useCallback(() => {
    const currentWindow = windowRef.current;
    if (!currentWindow) return null;
    const workArea = currentWindow.closest('.workspace_work_area');
    const isCollapsed = workArea?.classList.contains('is-right-collapsed');
    if (isCollapsed) {
      return currentWindow.closest('.workspace_canvas') || currentWindow.parentElement;

<sub>108m 50s</sub>

### Reasoning

*I'm planning the drag handling: compute the bounds once at the start, clamp the position on each move, and let a requestAnimationFrame write the transform directly, then commit the final position and persist it on release. Resize follows the same pattern, caching the max edges up front and writing size changes through the frame callback.

I'm weighing whether memoizing the export and the body component is worth it, since the window item only changes its metadata once per drag. I also want guards so focus only fires when the window isn't already active, in both the mouse-down and drag-start paths. Then there's the question of whether a mid-drag re-render would reset the transform, which I think it won't, since the state position hasn't changed.

I'm reworking drag and resize to measure bounds once at gesture start, write to the DOM during the gesture, and persist React state on pointerup, with the window memoized and focus sent only when inactive.*

import React, { useMemo, useReducer } from 'react';

import { initialWorkspaceState, workspaceReducer } from './workspaceReducer.js';
import { WORKSPACE_ACTIONS } from './workspaceTypes.js';
import { WorkspaceActionsContext, WorkspaceContext } from './workspaceContext.js';

function createWorkspaceActions(dispatch) {
  return {
    openWindow: (type, options = {}) => dispatch({
      type: WORKSPACE_ACTIONS.OPEN_WINDOW,
      payload: { ...options, type },
    }),
    closeWindow: (id) => dispatch({
      type: WORKSPACE_ACTIONS.CLOSE_WINDOW,
      payload: { id },
    }),
    focusWindow: (id) => dispatch({
      type: WORKSPACE_ACTIONS.FOCUS_WINDOW,
      payload: { id },
    }),
    reorderWindows: (draggedId, targetId) => dispatch({
      type: WORKSPACE_ACTIONS.REORDER_WINDOWS,
      payload: { draggedId, targetId },
    }),
    updateWindowCustomTitle: (id, customTitle) => dispatch({
      type: WORKSPACE_ACTIONS.UPDATE_WINDOW_CUSTOM_TITLE,
      payload: { id, customTitle },
    }),
    updateWindowMetadata: (id, updates) => dispatch({
      type: WORKSPACE_ACTIONS.UPDATE_WINDOW_METADATA,
      payload: { id, updates },
    }),
    setOrientation: (orientation) => dispatch({
      type: WORKSPACE_ACTIONS.SET_ORIENTATION,
      payload: { orientation },
    }),
    toggleOrientation: () => dispatch({
      type: WORKSPACE_ACTIONS.TOGGLE_ORIENTATION,
    }),
    setContextTab: (tab) => dispatch({
      type: WORKSPACE_ACTIONS.SET_CONTEXT_TAB,
      payload: { tab },
    }),
    clearWindows: () => dispatch({ type: WORKSPACE_ACTIONS.CLEAR_WINDOWS }),
  };
}

export function WorkspaceProvider({ children }) {
  const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(workspaceReducer, initialWorkspaceState);
  const actions = useMemo(() => createWorkspaceActions(dispatch), []);

  const value = useMemo(() => {
    const activeWindow = state.windows.find((windowItem) => windowItem.id === state.activeWindowId) || null;
    return { ...state, activeWindow, ...actions };
  }, [state, actions]);

  return (
    <WorkspaceActionsContext.Provider value={actions}>
      <WorkspaceContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</WorkspaceContext.Provider>
    </WorkspaceActionsContext.Provider>

}

export function useWorkspace() {

import React, { memo } from 'react';

import SourceWindowBody from '../../features/source/components/SourceWindowBody.jsx';
import SettingsWindowBody from '../../features/settings/components/SettingsWindowBody.jsx';
import { WORKSPACE_WINDOW_TYPES } from '../state/workspaceTypes.js';

// Header-only fields: editing them must not re-render the (heavy) window body.
const HEADER_ONLY_KEYS = new Set(['customTitle', 'updatedAt']);

const areBodyPropsEqual = (prev, next) => {
  const a = prev.windowItem;
  const b = next.windowItem;
  if (a === b) return true;
  const keys = new Set([...Object.keys(a), ...Object.keys(b)]);
  for (const key of keys) {
    if (!HEADER_ONLY_KEYS.has(key) && a[key] !== b[key]) return false;
  }
  return true;
};

function WorkspaceWindowBody({ windowItem }) {
  if (windowItem.type === WORKSPACE_WINDOW_TYPES.SOURCE) {
    return <SourceWindowBody windowItem={windowItem} />;
  }

  if (windowItem.type === WORKSPACE_WINDOW_TYPES.SETTINGS) {
    return <SettingsWindowBody windowItem={windowItem} />;
  }

  return (
    <div className="workspace_window_body">
      <p>{windowItem.title} workspace placeholder</p>
    </div>
  );
}

export default memo(WorkspaceWindowBody, areBodyPropsEqual);

export default function WorkspaceFrame({ user, token, apiUrl, mainSessionId, sessionError, onSignOut, logoSrc }) {
  const displayName = user?.display_name || user?.username || user?.client_id || 'Analyst';
  const avatarLetter = displayName.trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase() || 'A';
  const launcherRef = React.useRef(null);
  const [isLauncherExpanded, setIsLauncherExpanded] = useState(false);
  const [isRightCollapsed, setIsRightCollapsed] = useState(false);
  const [sourceOpenError, setSourceOpenError] = useState('');
  const [isOpeningSource, setIsOpeningSource] = useState(false);
  const [isSidebarOverviewOpen, setIsSidebarOverviewOpen] = useState(false);
  const workspace = useWorkspace();


  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isLauncherExpanded) return undefined;

    const handleOutsidePointerDown = (event) => {
      if (launcherRef.current?.contains(event.target)) return;
      setIsLauncherExpanded(false);
      setIsSidebarOverviewOpen(false);
    };

    document.addEventListener('pointerdown', handleOutsidePointerDown, true);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('pointerdown', handleOutsidePointerDown, true);
  }, [isLauncherExpanded]);

  const collapseLauncher = () => {
    setIsLauncherExpanded(false);
    setIsSidebarOverviewOpen(false);
  };

  const handleCloseWindow = (windowId) => {
    const targetWindow = workspace.windows.find((windowItem) => windowItem.id === windowId);
    if (targetWindow?.type === WORKSPACE_WINDOW_TYPES.SOURCE && token) {
      closeSourceWindow(apiUrl, token, {
        sessionId: targetWindow.parentSessionId,
        windowId: targetWindow.backendWindowId,
        reason: 'user_closed_window',
      }).catch((error) => {
        console.error('Source window cleanup failed', { status: error?.status, message: error?.message });
      });
    }
    workspace.closeWindow(windowId);
  };

  const windowWorkspace = {
    ...workspace,
    closeWindow: handleCloseWindow,
  };

  const handleLauncherAction = async (item) => {
    setSourceOpenError('');
    collapseLauncher();

    if (item.windowType === WORKSPACE_WINDOW_TYPES.SOURCE) {
      if (!mainSessionId || !token) {
        setSourceOpenError('Session is not ready yet.');
        return;

      const sourceWindowId = workspace.nextSourceWindowId;
      setIsOpeningSource(true);
      try {
        const identity = await initializeSourceWindow(apiUrl, token, {
          sessionId: mainSessionId,
          windowId: sourceWindowId,
        });
        workspace.openWindow(item.windowType, {
          contextTab: item.contextTab,
          title: item.label,
          backendWindowId: identity.windowId,
          parentSessionId: identity.parentSessionId,
          sourceSessionId: identity.sourceSessionId,
        });
        workspace.setContextTab(item.contextTab);
      } catch (error) {
        setSourceOpenError(error?.message || 'Source window could not be initialized.');
      } finally {
        setIsOpeningSource(false);
      }
      return;
    }

    workspace.openWindow(item.windowType, {
      contextTab: item.contextTab,
      title: item.label,
    });
    workspace.setContextTab(item.contextTab);

        <aside ref={launcherRef} className="workspace_zone workspace_zone_left" aria-label="Workspace launcher">
          <nav className="workspace_launcher" aria-label="Workspace launcher">

import React, { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { THEME_COMPONENT_CATEGORIES } from './themeCategories.js';
import { THEME_PRESETS } from './presets/index.js';

export const THEMES = [
  { id: 'nbe-daylight', name: 'NBE Daylight', description: 'Bright golden & dark blue master skin (#f6efea / #131e2a / #FCC676)', previewColor: '#FCC676' },
  { id: 'dark', name: 'Deep Space', description: 'Classic dark sci-fi HUD with cyan accents (#131e2a)', previewColor: '#1c98a5' },
  { id: 'emerald-dark', name: 'Emerald Dark', description: 'Deep forest dark slate with emerald accents (#0a1c17)', previewColor: '#10b981' },
  { id: 'cyberpunk', name: 'Cyberpunk Neon', description: 'Neon dark violet with magenta accents (#0b071a)', previewColor: '#ff007f' },
  { id: 'solarized-dark', name: 'Solarized Dark', description: 'Deep solarized teal with amber accents (#002b36)', previewColor: '#b58900' },
  { id: 'light-clean', name: 'Daylight Clean', description: 'Bright slate layout with crisp teal accents (#f4f7fa)', previewColor: '#0d9488' },
  { id: 'solarized-light', name: 'Solarized Light', description: 'Warm solarized cream with blue & amber accents (#fdf6e3)', previewColor: '#268bd2' },
  { id: 'nbe-darknight', name: 'NBE Darknight', description: 'Midnight enterprise dark layout with sky blue & gold accents (#0f172a)', previewColor: '#38bdf8' },
];

const ThemeContext = createContext();

export function ThemeProvider({ children }) {
  const [theme, setThemeState] = useState(() => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem('linkx_theme_mode');
      if (savedTheme && THEMES.some((t) => t.id === savedTheme)) {
        return savedTheme;
      }
    }
    return 'nbe-daylight';
  });

  const [customOverrides, setCustomOverrides] = useState(() => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      try {
        const savedOverrides = localStorage.getItem('linkx_theme_custom_overrides');
        return savedOverrides ? JSON.parse(savedOverrides) : {};
      } catch {
        return {};
      }
    }
    return {};
  });

  const [inspectorActive, setInspectorActive] = useState(false);

  const setTheme = (newTheme) => {
    if (THEMES.some((t) => t.id === newTheme)) {
      setThemeState(newTheme);
    }
  };

  const setCustomVariable = (varName, value) => {
    setCustomOverrides((prev) => {
      const updated = { ...prev };
      if (value === undefined || value === null) {
        delete updated[varName];
      } else {
        updated[varName] = value;
      }
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        localStorage.setItem('linkx_theme_custom_overrides', JSON.stringify(updated));
      }
      return updated;
    });
  };

  const applyPreset = (preset) => {
    if (!preset) return;
    if (preset.baseTheme && THEMES.some((t) => t.id === preset.baseTheme)) {
      setThemeState(preset.baseTheme);
    }
    const nextOverrides = preset.overrides || {};
    setCustomOverrides((prev) => {
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        // Remove inline props that are not part of the preset being applied.
        Object.keys(prev).forEach((key) => {
          if (!(key in nextOverrides)) {
            document.documentElement.style.removeProperty(key);
          }
        });
        localStorage.setItem('linkx_theme_custom_overrides', JSON.stringify(nextOverrides));
      }
      return nextOverrides;
    });
  };

  const resetCustomOverrides = () => {
    setCustomOverrides({});
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      localStorage.removeItem('linkx_theme_custom_overrides');
      // Remove inline style properties from root element
      Object.keys(customOverrides).forEach((key) => {
        document.documentElement.style.removeProperty(key);
      });
    }
  };

  const exportThemeConfig = () => {
    return JSON.stringify({ theme, customOverrides }, null, 2);
  };

  const importThemeConfig = (jsonString) => {
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(jsonString);
      if (parsed.theme && THEMES.some((t) => t.id === parsed.theme)) {
        setTheme(parsed.theme);
      }
      if (parsed.customOverrides && typeof parsed.customOverrides === 'object') {
        setCustomOverrides(parsed.customOverrides);
        if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
          localStorage.setItem('linkx_theme_custom_overrides', JSON.stringify(parsed.customOverrides));
        }
      }
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Failed to import theme configuration:', e);
      return false;
    }
  };

  const toggleInspector = () => setInspectorActive((prev) => !prev);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', theme);
      localStorage.setItem('linkx_theme_mode', theme);

      // Apply custom variable overrides directly to documentElement style
      Object.entries(customOverrides).forEach(([key, val]) => {
        if (val) {
          document.documentElement.style.setProperty(key, val);
        } else {
          document.documentElement.style.removeProperty(key);
        }
      });
    }
  }, [theme, customOverrides]);

  return (
    <ThemeContext.Provider
      value={{
        theme,
        setTheme,
        themes: THEMES,
        categories: THEME_COMPONENT_CATEGORIES,
        customOverrides,
        setCustomVariable,
        resetCustomOverrides,
        presets: THEME_PRESETS,
        applyPreset,
        exportThemeConfig,
        importThemeConfig,
        inspectorActive,
        toggleInspector,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </ThemeContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useTheme() {
  const context = useContext(ThemeContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useTheme must be used within a ThemeProvider');
  }
  return context;
}

import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';

const DEFAULT_EVENTS = ['mousemove', 'mousedown', 'keydown', 'touchstart', 'scroll'];

export function useIdleTimeout({
  enabled = true,
  warningMs = 12 * 60 * 1000,
  lockMs = 15 * 60 * 1000,
  timeoutMs = 30 * 60 * 1000,
  isLocked = false,
  onWarn,
  onLock,
  onTimeout,
}) {
  const lastActivityRef = useRef(Date.now());
  const hasWarnedRef = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled) return undefined;

    const handleActivity = () => {
      if (!isLocked) {
        lastActivityRef.current = Date.now();
        hasWarnedRef.current = false;
      }
    };

    DEFAULT_EVENTS.forEach((eventName) => {
      window.addEventListener(eventName, handleActivity, { passive: true });
    });

    const intervalId = setInterval(() => {
      const now = Date.now();
      const elapsed = now - lastActivityRef.current;

      if (!isLocked) {
        if (elapsed >= warningMs && !hasWarnedRef.current) {
          hasWarnedRef.current = true;
          onWarn?.();
        }
        if (elapsed >= lockMs) {
          onLock?.();
        }
      } else {
        if (elapsed >= timeoutMs) {
          onTimeout?.();
        }
      }
    }, 5000);

    return () => {
      DEFAULT_EVENTS.forEach((eventName) => {
        window.removeEventListener(eventName, handleActivity);
      });
      clearInterval(intervalId);
    };
  }, [enabled, isLocked, warningMs, lockMs, timeoutMs, onWarn, onLock, onTimeout]);
}

*I've confirmed the theme block covers lines 19 to 2084, with the first 18 lines being global rules that stay in main.css. Next I'm writing the dry-run mapping script: for each root literal component token, compute its effective daylight value, find a matching semantic token by role, and report coverage against the dark theme's explicit values.

I'm working out how to match each component color to a semantic token. The plan is to resolve effective daylight values by overlaying block 1932 on the root, then score candidates by role from the token name and by matching rgb values.

I'm settling on the color-mix rule: if the semantic token matches the component's alpha, I can reference it directly with var(); if the semantic is opaque, I scale it with a percentage against transparent, which keeps the rgb intact. I also want to check that the semantic token isn't being applied where a component token should stay independent.

I'm worried about white text: a #fff text color on dark chrome would get mapped to --input-bg if I allowed fallback matching by value alone, and it would turn invisible in dark mode. So I'll require a role-compatible semantic match, and leave the color literal when none exists, classifying text tokens by names containing "-text".

I'm making a role-based classifier for token names, with accent tokens counting as usable for any role. Then I want to check whether any white text color would get mapped to an input background, since that would make it invisible in dark mode, and run the dry-run script with a dark-theme validation pass.

I'm deciding to write the dry-run script in the session folder rather than the repo, since it's a one-off migration tool, and I'll use it to check how faithfully the derived dark-theme values match the explicit ones.

The semantic tier is settled at 71 tokens, so I'm rewriting each literal daylight token as a reference to a same-role semantic token, with color-mix() for alpha variants. Doing a dry run first.*

CSS='/var/www/linkx-frontend/incubation/src/main.css'
s=open(CSS).read()
blocks=[(m.group(1).strip(),m.group(2),m.start(),m.end()) for m in re.finditer(r'^((?::root|\[data-theme)[^{]*)\{(.*?)^\}',s,re.M|re.S)]
def decls(body): return dict((k,v.strip()) for k,v in re.findall(r'^\s*(--[\w-]+)\s*:\s*([^;]+);',body,re.M))

SEM=set.intersection(*[set(d) for d in D[2:]])
root=D[0]; day={**root, **D[7]}  # effective daylight
COLOR=re.compile(r'#[0-9a-fA-F]{8}\b|#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}\b|#[0-9a-fA-F]{4}\b|#[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\b|rgba?\(\s*[\d.]+\s*,\s*[\d.]+\s*,\s*[\d.]+\s*(?:,\s*[\d.]+\s*)?\)')
def parse(c):
    if c.startswith('#'):
        h=c[1:]
        if len(h) in (3,4): h=''.join(ch*2 for ch in h)
        r,g,b=int(h[0:2],16),int(h[2:4],16),int(h[4:6],16); a=int(h[6:8],16)/255 if len(h)==8 else 1.0
        return (r,g,b,round(a,3))
    n=[float(x) for x in re.findall(r'[\d.]+',c)]
    return (int(n[0]),int(n[1]),int(n[2]),round(n[3] if len(n)>3 else 1.0,3))
def role(name):
    n=name.lower()
    if re.search(r'shadow|glow',n): return 'shadow'
    if re.search(r'border|divider|outline|ring',n): return 'border'
    if re.search(r'text|-color$|-fg|icon|label|placeholder|title|caret',n): return 'text'
    return 'bg'
ACCENT={'--accent','--accent-strong','--linkx-accent','--linkx-accent-strong'}
GENERIC=['--accent','--accent-strong','--app-text','--app-bg','--muted-text','--panel-bg','--panel-border','--panel-shadow','--input-bg','--input-border']
semcol={}
for k in SEM:
    v=day[k]
    if COLOR.fullmatch(v.strip()): semcol[k]=parse(v.strip())
def pick(name,c):
    r=role(name); best=None
    for k,sc in semcol.items():
        if sc[:3]!=c[:3]: continue
        if sc[3]<c[3]-1e-6: continue
        srole='any' if k in ACCENT else role(k)
        if srole not in ('any',r): continue
        score=(2 if srole==r else 1) + (1 if k in GENERIC else 0) + (1 if abs(sc[3]-c[3])<1e-6 else 0)
        if not best or score>best[0] or (score==best[0] and k<best[1]): best=(score,k)
    if not best: return None
    k=best[1]; sa=semcol[k][3]
    if abs(sa-c[3])<1e-6: return f'var({k})'
    pct=round(c[3]/sa*100,2)
    pct=int(pct) if pct==int(pct) else pct
    return f'color-mix(in srgb, var({k}) {pct}%, transparent)'
def convert(name,val):
    if 'var(' in val: return val,0,0
    hits=miss=0
    def sub(m):

        rep=pick(name,parse(m.group(0)))
        if rep: hits+=1; return rep
        miss+=1; return m.group(0)
    return COLOR.sub(sub,val),hits,miss
if __name__=='__main__':
    conv={};full=part=none=nocolor=0
    for k,v in root.items():

    print(f"component tokens: full={full} partial={part} unmapped={none} non-color={nocolor}")
    # validate vs dark explicit

            m=re.fullmatch(r'var\((--[\w-]+)\)',nv)
            if m:
                dv=darkeff[m.group(1)]
                if dv.replace(' ','').lower()==dark[k].replace(' ','').lower(): same+=1
                else:
                    diff+=1
                    if len(samples)<12: samples.append((k,nv,dark[k],dv))
    print(f"dark explicit vs derived (exact var only): same={same} diff={diff}")
    for x in samples: print("  ",x)
    json.dump(conv,open('/tmp/conv.json','w'),indent=1)
    import itertools
    print("sample conversions:")

/**

 * Each entry must have a matching src/styles/themes/<id>.css that defines
 * every semantic token (verified by `npm run theme:check`).
 */
export const DEFAULT_THEME_ID = 'nbe-daylight';

export const THEMES = [
  { id: 'nbe-daylight', name: 'NBE Daylight', colorScheme: 'light', description: 'Bright golden & dark blue master skin (#f6efea / #131e2a / #FCC676)', previewColor: '#FCC676' },
  { id: 'dark', name: 'Deep Space', colorScheme: 'dark', description: 'Classic dark sci-fi HUD with cyan accents (#131e2a)', previewColor: '#1c98a5' },
  { id: 'emerald-dark', name: 'Emerald Dark', colorScheme: 'dark', description: 'Deep forest dark slate with emerald accents (#0a1c17)', previewColor: '#10b981' },
  { id: 'cyberpunk', name: 'Cyberpunk Neon', colorScheme: 'dark', description: 'Neon dark violet with magenta accents (#0b071a)', previewColor: '#ff007f' },
  { id: 'solarized-dark', name: 'Solarized Dark', colorScheme: 'dark', description: 'Deep solarized teal with amber accents (#002b36)', previewColor: '#b58900' },
  { id: 'light-clean', name: 'Daylight Clean', colorScheme: 'light', description: 'Bright slate layout with crisp teal accents (#f4f7fa)', previewColor: '#0d9488' },
  { id: 'solarized-light', name: 'Solarized Light', colorScheme: 'light', description: 'Warm solarized cream with blue & amber accents (#fdf6e3)', previewColor: '#268bd2' },
  { id: 'nbe-darknight', name: 'NBE Darknight', colorScheme: 'dark', description: 'Midnight enterprise dark layout with sky blue & gold accents (#0f172a)', previewColor: '#38bdf8' },
];

export const isKnownTheme = (id) => THEMES.some((t) => t.id === id);

export const THEME_STORAGE_KEY = 'linkx_theme_mode';
/** Per-theme overrides: { [themeId]: { '--var': 'value' } } */
export const OVERRIDES_STORAGE_KEY = 'linkx_theme_overrides_by_theme';
/** Legacy flat overrides (pre per-theme). Read once for migration, never written. */
export const LEGACY_OVERRIDES_STORAGE_KEY = 'linkx_theme_custom_overrides';

export function readStoredOverrides(fallbackThemeId) {
  try {
    const stored = localStorage.getItem(OVERRIDES_STORAGE_KEY);
    if (stored) return JSON.parse(stored) || {};
    const legacy = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(LEGACY_OVERRIDES_STORAGE_KEY) || 'null');
    if (legacy && typeof legacy === 'object' && Object.keys(legacy).length > 0) {
      return { [fallbackThemeId]: legacy };
    }
  } catch {
    // Corrupt storage: start clean.
  }
  return {};
}

$ cd /var/www/linkx-frontend/incubation && cat > src/shared/theme/ThemePicker.jsx <<'EOF'
import React from 'react';

import { useTheme } from './ThemeContext.jsx';

/**
 * Shared theme selector used by every theme surface (context panel, right
 * settings tab, settings window).
 *  - variant "cards": descriptive grid; "pills": compact row.
 *  - showPresets: also list repo-committed presets (src/shared/theme/presets).
 */
export default function ThemePicker({ variant = 'cards', showPresets = false }) {
  const { theme, setTheme, themes, presets, applyPreset } = useTheme();

  const themeList = variant === 'pills' ? (
    <div className="theme_studio_preset_pills" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Theme">
      {themes.map((t) => (
        <button
          key={t.id}
          type="button"
          role="radio"
          aria-checked={theme === t.id}
          className={`theme_studio_pill ${theme === t.id ? 'is-active' : ''}`}
          onClick={() => setTheme(t.id)}
        >
          <span className="theme_studio_pill_dot" style={{ backgroundColor: t.previewColor }} />
          <span>{t.name}</span>
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  ) : (
    <div className="workspace_theme_picker_grid" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Theme">
      {themes.map((t) => (
        <button
          key={t.id}
          type="button"
          role="radio"
          aria-checked={theme === t.id}
          className={`workspace_theme_option ${theme === t.id ? 'is-selected' : ''}`}
          onClick={() => setTheme(t.id)}
        >
          <div className="workspace_theme_preview_header">
            <span className="workspace_theme_color_badge" style={{ backgroundColor: t.previewColor }} />
            <span className="workspace_theme_name">{t.name}</span>
            {theme === t.id && <span className="workspace_theme_active_badge">Active</span>}
          </div>
          <small className="workspace_theme_desc">{t.description}</small>
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  );

  if (!showPresets) return themeList;

  return (
    <>
      {themeList}
      <h3 className="workspace_context_subheading">Custom presets</h3>
      {presets.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="workspace_context_hint">
          No presets committed yet. Use “Save current as preset…”, then drop the file into
          <code> src/shared/theme/presets/</code> and commit it.
        </p>
      ) : (
        <div className="workspace_preset_list">
          {presets.map((preset) => (
            <button
              key={preset.id}
              type="button"
              className="workspace_preset_option"
              onClick={() => applyPreset(preset)}
            >
              <strong>{preset.name}</strong>
              {preset.description && <small>{preset.description}</small>}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
}
EOF

### `bash`

**Add theme:check script and run**

```
$ cd /var/www/linkx-frontend/incubation && mkdir -p scripts && cat > scripts/theme-check.mjs <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * Theme integrity check: `npm run theme:check`
 *
 * Errors (exit 1):
 *  - registry theme without a CSS file / not imported in themes/index.css
 *  - theme missing any semantic token (semantic tier = tokens of nbe-daylight.css :root block)
 *  - custom-property reference cycles
 * Warnings:
 *  - var(--x) used without fallback and never defined
 *  - Theme Studio (themeCategories.js) keys that no CSS defines
 * Info:
 *  - component tokens still holding literal colors (candidates for semantic mapping)
 */
import { readFileSync, readdirSync, existsSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join, dirname } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const root = join(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');
const themesDir = join(root, 'src/styles/themes');
const read = (p) => readFileSync(p, 'utf8');
const stripComments = (css) => css.replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g, '');
const declsOf = (css) => {
  const out = new Map();
  for (const m of stripComments(css).matchAll(/(--[\w-]+)\s*:\s*([^;]+);/g)) out.set(m[1], m[2].trim());
  return out;
};

const { THEMES, DEFAULT_THEME_ID } = await import(join(root, 'src/shared/theme/themeRegistry.js'));
const { THEME_COMPONENT_CATEGORIES } = await import(join(root, 'src/shared/theme/themeCategories.js'));

const errors = [];
const warnings = [];

const indexCss = read(join(themesDir, 'index.css'));
const defaultCss = stripComments(read(join(themesDir, `${DEFAULT_THEME_ID}.css`)));
const semanticBlock = defaultCss.match(/:root[^{]*\{([\s\S]*?)\}/);
const semantic = [...declsOf(semanticBlock ? semanticBlock[1] : '').keys()];

for (const theme of THEMES) {
  const file = join(themesDir, `${theme.id}.css`);
  if (!existsSync(file)) { errors.push(`theme "${theme.id}": missing src/styles/themes/${theme.id}.css`); continue; }
  if (!indexCss.includes(`'./${theme.id}.css'`)) errors.push(`theme "${theme.id}": not imported in themes/index.css`);
  if (theme.id === DEFAULT_THEME_ID) continue;
  const defined = declsOf(read(file));
  const missing = semantic.filter((k) => !defined.has(k));
  if (missing.length) errors.push(`theme "${theme.id}": missing ${missing.length} semantic token(s): ${missing.join(', ')}`);
}

// Collect every definition and usage across theme files + stylesheets + JSX/JS.
const cssFiles = [
  ...readdirSync(themesDir).filter((f) => f.endsWith('.css')).map((f) => join(themesDir, f)),
  join(root, 'src/main.css'),
  join(root, 'src/index.css'),
];
const walk = (dir) => readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true }).flatMap((e) => (
  e.isDirectory() ? walk(join(dir, e.name)) : /\.(jsx?|css)$/.test(e.name) ? [join(dir, e.name)] : []
));
const sources = [...new Set([...cssFiles, ...walk(join(root, 'src'))])];

const defined = new Set();
const graph = new Map();
const unresolved = new Map();
for (const file of sources) {
  const text = stripComments(read(file));
  for (const [k, v] of declsOf(text)) {
    defined.add(k);
    const refs = graph.get(k) || new Set();
    for (const m of v.matchAll(/var\((--[\w-]+)/g)) refs.add(m[1]);
    graph.set(k, refs);
  }
  // JS may set variables via setProperty('--x') / style objects.
  for (const m of text.matchAll(/['"`](--[\w-]+)['"`]\s*[:,)]/g)) defined.add(m[1]);
  for (const m of text.matchAll(/var\((--[\w-]+)\s*\)/g)) {
    if (!unresolved.has(m[1])) unresolved.set(m[1], file.replace(root + '/', ''));
  }
}
const undefinedVars = [...unresolved].filter(([k]) => !defined.has(k));
if (undefinedVars.length) {
  warnings.push(`${undefinedVars.length} var() reference(s) without fallback are never defined:\n` +
    undefinedVars.map(([k, f]) => `    ${k}  (${f})`).join('\n'));
}

// Cycle detection over custom-property references.
const state = new Map();
const cycles = [];
const visit = (node, path) => {
  state.set(node, 1);
  for (const next of graph.get(node) || []) {
    if (state.get(next) === 1) cycles.push([...path, next].join(' -> '));
    else if (!state.has(next)) visit(next, [...path, next]);
  }
  state.set(node, 2);
};
for (const node of graph.keys()) if (!state.has(node)) visit(node, [node]);
cycles.forEach((c) => errors.push(`custom property cycle: ${c}`));

const studioKeys = THEME_COMPONENT_CATEGORIES.flatMap((c) => (c.tokens || []).map((t) => t.key));
const studioMissing = [...new Set(studioKeys)].filter((k) => !defined.has(k));
if (studioMissing.length) warnings.push(`${studioMissing.length} Theme Studio key(s) not defined in CSS: ${studioMissing.join(', ')}`);

const componentTokens = declsOf(read(join(themesDir, 'tokens.css')));
const literal = [...componentTokens].filter(([, v]) => !v.includes('var(') && /#[0-9a-f]{3,8}\b|rgba?\(/i.test(v));

console.log(`Themes: ${THEMES.length} | semantic tokens: ${semantic.length} | component tokens: ${componentTokens.size} (${literal.length} literal colors)`);
warnings.forEach((w) => console.warn(`warn  ${w}`));
errors.forEach((e) => console.error(`error ${e}`));
console.log(errors.length ? `\n✖ ${errors.length} error(s), ${warnings.length} warning(s)` : `\n✔ themes OK (${warnings.length} warning(s))`);
process.exit(errors.length ? 1 : 0);
EOF
python3 - <<'EOF'
import json,collections
p='package.json'; d=json.load(open(p),object_pairs_hook=collections.OrderedDict)
d['scripts']['theme:check']='node scripts/theme-check.mjs'
open(p,'w').write(json.dumps(d,indent=2)+'\n')
EOF
npm run -s theme:check
```

# Styles

Component styles still live in `src/main.css`; theme tokens live in `themes/`.

## Theme architecture (`themes/`)

Tokens are layered so a theme only defines a small, stable set of values:

| Tier | Where | What |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Semantic | `themes/<theme-id>.css` | ~71 tokens: surfaces, text, borders, accent, actions (`--app-bg`, `--accent`, `--linkx-window-bg`, …). **Every theme must define all of them.** |
| Component | `themes/tokens.css` | ~840 tokens (`--central-*`, `--right-*`, `--window-*`, …) that default to `var(--semantic)` or `color-mix(in srgb, var(--semantic) N%, transparent)`. |
| Overrides | Theme Studio (runtime) | Inline CSS vars on `<html>`, stored **per theme** in `localStorage` (`linkx_theme_overrides_by_theme`). |

`nbe-daylight.css` defines the semantic tier on `:root`, so it is also the fallback for every theme.
A theme may override component tokens when it needs a deliberate deviation (see `dark.css`).

### Adding a theme

1. Copy `themes/emerald-dark.css` to `themes/<id>.css`, change the selector to `[data-theme="<id>"]` and the values.
2. Add `@import './<id>.css';` to `themes/index.css`.
3. Register it in `src/shared/theme/themeRegistry.js` (`id`, `name`, `colorScheme`, `previewColor`).
4. Run `npm run theme:check`. It fails on missing semantic tokens, unregistered files and `var()` cycles.

### Rules

- Component CSS uses component tokens (or semantic ones). Don't hard-code colors in `main.css`.
- New component tokens go in `tokens.css` and must reference a semantic token unless they are theme-neutral (status colors, black shadows).
- The pre-paint boot script in `index.html` mirrors the storage keys in `themeRegistry.js`. Keep them in sync.
EOF

import React, { memo } from 'react';

import SourceWindowBody from '../../features/source/components/SourceWindowBody.jsx';
import SettingsWindowBody from '../../features/settings/components/SettingsWindowBody.jsx';
import { WORKSPACE_WINDOW_TYPES } from '../state/workspaceTypes.js';

// Header-only fields: editing them must not re-render the (heavy) window body.
const HEADER_ONLY_KEYS = new Set(['customTitle', 'updatedAt']);

const areBodyPropsEqual = (prev, next) => {
  const a = prev.windowItem;
  const b = next.windowItem;
  if (a === b) return true;
  const keys = new Set([...Object.keys(a), ...Object.keys(b)]);
  for (const key of keys) {
    if (!HEADER_ONLY_KEYS.has(key) && a[key] !== b[key]) return false;
  }
  return true;
};

function WorkspaceWindowBody({ windowItem }) {
  if (windowItem.type === WORKSPACE_WINDOW_TYPES.SOURCE) {
    return <SourceWindowBody windowItem={windowItem} />;
  }

  if (windowItem.type === WORKSPACE_WINDOW_TYPES.SETTINGS) {
    return <SettingsWindowBody windowItem={windowItem} />;
  }

  return (
    <div className="workspace_window_body">
      <p>{windowItem.title} workspace placeholder</p>
    </div>
  );
}

export default memo(WorkspaceWindowBody, areBodyPropsEqual);

### Reasoning

*The dev server is set to poll every file every 100ms with `usePolling: true`, which costs server CPU and slows hot reload. That's server-side rather than browser lag, but it's still worth flagging. Polling was probably turned on for a mount issue like WSL, and /var/www on Linux is a native filesystem, so it's likely unnecessary. Changing it would need a server restart, and the user might have a reason for it, so I'll mention it rather than change it.

I'm weighing whether to change the polling interval, but the dev experience cost is real, so I'll leave the config alone and flag it. With only react and react-dom left after removal, the manualChunks setup isn't needed, so I'll skip it. I should check whether the incubation has its own node_modules before running npm uninstall, since doing that while the dev server runs could make Vite re-optimize deps, which is fine.

After removing the extra packages, only React and React DOM remain as runtime deps, so vendor chunking isn't needed. I'm also flagging that the Vite config's `usePolling: true, interval: 100` makes the dev server poll every file ten times a second, and I'm uninstalling the packages now.*

export function useIdleTimeout({
  enabled = true,
  warningMs = 12 * 60 * 1000,
  lockMs = 15 * 60 * 1000,
  timeoutMs = 30 * 60 * 1000,
  isLocked = false,
  onWarn,
  onLock,
  onTimeout,
}) {
  const lastActivityRef = useRef(Date.now());
  const hasWarnedRef = useRef(false);
  // Keep latest callbacks without re-subscribing listeners on every render.
  const callbacksRef = useRef({ onWarn, onLock, onTimeout });
  callbacksRef.current = { onWarn, onLock, onTimeout };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled) return undefined;

    const handleActivity = () => {
      if (!isLocked) {
        lastActivityRef.current = Date.now();
        hasWarnedRef.current = false;
      }
    };

    DEFAULT_EVENTS.forEach((eventName) => {
      window.addEventListener(eventName, handleActivity, { passive: true });
    });

    const intervalId = setInterval(() => {
      const now = Date.now();
      const elapsed = now - lastActivityRef.current;

      if (!isLocked) {
        if (elapsed >= warningMs && !hasWarnedRef.current) {
          hasWarnedRef.current = true;
          callbacksRef.current.onWarn?.();
        }
        if (elapsed >= lockMs) {
          callbacksRef.current.onLock?.();
        }
      } else {
        if (elapsed >= timeoutMs) {
          callbacksRef.current.onTimeout?.();
        }
      }
    }, 5000);

    return () => {
      DEFAULT_EVENTS.forEach((eventName) => {
        window.removeEventListener(eventName, handleActivity);
      });
      clearInterval(intervalId);
    };
  }, [enabled, isLocked, warningMs, lockMs, timeoutMs]);

<sub>192m 18s</sub>

### Copilot

I've made the next round of fixes. Since you see lag even with animations off, the main cause was probably expensive painting:

- **Window blur:** every window had a 20px glass blur, but windows are 88–96% opaque, so you couldn't really see it. It's now 8px. The dock went from 20px to 10px, and the message box and lock panel from 16px to 10px.
- **Window shadows:** the dark themes drew an 80px shadow around every window. That's now a tighter 32px shadow.
- **Element-picker rule:** a CSS rule that re-checked every element on the page is replaced by a class added to `<html>` only while the picker is on.
- **Transitions:** the 8 `transition: all` rules now animate only the properties that change.
- **Loading:** the Source and Settings windows and the element picker now load only when opened.
- **Packages:** removed the 5 unused packages. React and React DOM are now the only dependencies.

Lint shows 0 errors and `theme:check` passes. I haven't checked this in a browser. Hard-refresh `localhost:7154` and tell me where it still feels slow.

Two things outside these changes:
- Dev mode is always slower than a real build.
- `vite.config.js` has the dev server checking every file 10 times a second (`usePolling`, 100ms). That only uses machine CPU, not browser speed, but I can turn it off if you agree.

The blur and shadow changes make windows look slightly less glassy. You can raise the blur again in Theme Studio.

I'm weighing whether to target the blur selectors explicitly or use a broad rule keyed off an attribute on the html element, and I'll check how the background-animation preference is stored so the new setting can follow the same pattern.

Every blurred layer sits above the animated canvas, so the browser re-blurs them each frame, and a smaller radius only partly fixes it. I'm checking how the background-animation setting is stored so I can add a matching glass-effects toggle.*

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";

export const backgroundAnimationPreferenceKey = "linkx_enable_background_animations";
export const backgroundAnimationPreferenceEvent = "linkx_background_animation_preference_change";

export function readBackgroundAnimationPreference() {
  try {
    if (typeof window === "undefined" || typeof localStorage === "undefined") return false;

    const storedPreference = localStorage.getItem(backgroundAnimationPreferenceKey);
    if (storedPreference !== null) return storedPreference !== "false";

    return false;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

export function writeBackgroundAnimationPreference(enabled) {
  try {
    if (typeof localStorage !== "undefined") {
      localStorage.setItem(backgroundAnimationPreferenceKey, String(enabled));
    }
  } catch {
    // Ignore unavailable storage; still notify the current document.
  }

  if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
    window.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent(backgroundAnimationPreferenceEvent, { detail: { enabled } })
    );
  }
}

export function useBackgroundAnimations() {
  const [areBackgroundAnimationsEnabled, setAreBackgroundAnimationsEnabled] = useState(readBackgroundAnimationPreference);

  useEffect(() => {
    const syncBackgroundPreference = (event) => {
      const enabled = typeof event?.detail?.enabled === "boolean"
        ? event.detail.enabled
        : readBackgroundAnimationPreference();

      setAreBackgroundAnimationsEnabled(enabled);
    };

    window.addEventListener("storage", syncBackgroundPreference);
    window.addEventListener(backgroundAnimationPreferenceEvent, syncBackgroundPreference);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("storage", syncBackgroundPreference);
      window.removeEventListener(backgroundAnimationPreferenceEvent, syncBackgroundPreference);
    };
  }, []);

  const setBackgroundAnimationsEnabled = useCallback((enabled) => {
    const normalizedEnabled = !!enabled;
    setAreBackgroundAnimationsEnabled(normalizedEnabled);
    writeBackgroundAnimationPreference(normalizedEnabled);
  }, []);

  return { areBackgroundAnimationsEnabled, setBackgroundAnimationsEnabled };
}

<sub>198m 42s</sub>

### Copilot

I agree it was most likely the blur. All 12 backdrop-blur layers are now turned off by default, and those layers now paint as plain semi-transparent panels.

The problem was that each blurred layer (windows, dock, notices, dialogs, login panel) gets re-blurred whenever anything behind it repaints. Behind them sits the network background, so the browser was re-blurring constantly. Making the blur smaller last time only reduced that cost.

You can turn the blur back on with a new **"Glass Blur Effects"** switch, next to the existing background-motion toggle and also in Settings → Preferences. The setting is applied before the page first draws, so there's no flash on load.

Lint shows 0 errors and `theme:check` passes. I haven't checked it in a browser.

// React to canvas size changes from panel expand/collapse
  // - Canvas shrinks (panel expanding) → push windows left so they clear the panel
  // - Canvas grows (panel collapsing) → leave windows exactly where they are
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const currentWindow = windowRef.current;
    const canvasEl = currentWindow?.closest('.workspace_canvas');
    if (!canvasEl) return;

    let prevCanvasWidth = canvasEl.getBoundingClientRect().width;

    const handleBoundsChange = () => {
      const canvasRect = canvasEl.getBoundingClientRect();
      const currentCanvasWidth = canvasRect.width;
      const delta = currentCanvasWidth - prevCanvasWidth;

      if (delta < 0) {
        // Canvas shrank (panel expanding) → push windows left by the shrink amount
        const shrinkAmount = Math.abs(delta);
        setPosition((prevPos) => {
          const newX = Math.max(0, prevPos.x - shrinkAmount);
          return newX !== prevPos.x ? { x: newX, y: prevPos.y } : prevPos;
        });
      }
      // Canvas grew (panel collapsing) → do nothing, windows stay put

      prevCanvasWidth = currentCanvasWidth;
    };

    const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(handleBoundsChange);
    resizeObserver.observe(canvasEl);

    return () => resizeObserver.disconnect();
  }, []);

<sub>205m 57s</sub>

### Copilot

Yes, I found five more problems of the same kind and fixed them:

1. **Side-panel collapse and expand.** The animation changes the panel width, so the network background canvas threw away and rebuilt its whole image on every frame. It now rebuilds once, after the animation finishes, and the browser stretches the old image in between.
2. **Theme Studio color dragging.** Two hidden watchers (the network background and the home Analyze button labels) re-read every theme value on each color change. They now run at most once per frame.
3. **Theme Studio token list.** It asked the browser for the current styles separately for every token. It now asks once per render.
4. **Unused `swing` and `hueshift` animations.** Removed; nothing used them.
5. **Blur on other overlays.** The login panel, Analyze button overlay, chat scroll button, and dialog backdrops are now covered by the glass switch from last time.

I checked these and left them alone because they're already cheap or only run briefly:
- The always-running animations (status dot, chat typing dots, analyzing pulse) only change opacity or scale, which costs almost nothing, and the typing and analyzing ones only run while active.
- The tab entrance animation runs once per tab switch.
- Window repositioning during panel collapse stays inside each window.

Lint shows 0 errors and `theme:check` passes. I haven't checked these in a browser.

**Still slow by design, needs your call:**
- **Side panels slide by changing their width.** Each frame re-lays out the entire workspace. Making it truly smooth means sliding them in a different way, which changes how the layout behaves.
- **`main.css` is very large.** It has 617 `!important` and 149 `[class*=…]` selectors. That makes every style recalculation slower, and fixing it is the pending CSS cleanup.

Want me to take on either of those next?

### Copilot

The quick analysis panel and the windows now stay inside the central workspace. Lint is clean and the dev server serves the changes, but I haven't seen it in a browser.

**Windows**
- When a window opens, and whenever the workspace changes size (browser resize, side panels opening or closing), it shrinks and moves to fit fully inside the workspace. That includes windows saved earlier at a large size.
- The minimum window size (640×420) no longer forces a window past the edge on small screens.

**Quick analysis and overview panels**
- They're capped at the visible height. If the content is taller, the panel scrolls inside itself with the themed scrollbar, so nothing is cut off.
- They use tighter padding and spacing on screens shorter than 900px, and tighter again under 720px.
- During an analysis, the panel jumps to the top and stops scrolling so the progress overlay stays fully visible.

One tradeoff: tooltips or pop-outs inside these panels that sit right at an edge may now be clipped. Hard-refresh, check, and tell me if anything still feels cramped or cut off.

$ cd /tmp && python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
css=open('nbe.css',errors='ignore').read()+open('nbe.html',errors='ignore').read()
keys=['astglobalcolor0','astglobalcolor1','astglobalcolor4','48d5cc8','9dc7ac7','bcc1dd6','2beac3f','color-primary','ast-global-color-0','ast-global-color-1','ast-global-color-4']

    if any(k in body for k in keys):
        decls=[d for d in body.split(';') if any(k in d for k in keys)]
        print(sel.strip()[-90:],' => ',';'.join(decls)[:170])
EOF

import re,sys,json,collections
base='/var/www/linkx-frontend/incubation/src/styles/themes/'
def decls(css):
    return {m.group(1):m.group(2).strip() for m in re.finditer(r'(--[\w-]+)\s*:\s*([^;]+);',css)}
day=open(base+'nbe-daylight.css').read()
tok=decls(open(base+'tokens.css').read())
env={}; env.update(tok); env.update(decls(day))
def res(v,d=0):
    if d>20: return v
    return re.sub(r'var\((--[\w-]+)(?:,\s*([^()]*(?:\([^()]*\))?[^()]*))?\)', lambda m: res(env.get(m.group(1), m.group(2) or '??'),d+1), v)
out={k:res(v) for k,v in tok.items()}
json.dump(out,open('/tmp/resolved.json','w'),indent=0)
c=collections.Counter()
for v in out.values():
    for col in re.findall(r'#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}\b|rgba?\([^)]*\)',v): c[col.lower()]+=1
for col,n in c.most_common(60): print(n,col)
EOF
python3 /home/uadmin/.copilot/session-state/19393ac9-98e6-452a-bd78-91c58bff50a9/files/resolve_tokens.py

### Copilot

I've restyled NBE Daylight to use the official colours from nbe.gov.et. Lint and `theme:check` pass and the dev server serves the files, but I haven't looked at it in a browser.

**What changed (only the NBE Daylight theme):**
- **Background:** the beige canvas is now a white to ice-blue (`#F4F7FA`, `#E8EFF7`) wash, like the NBE site.
- **Text:** navy `#131E2A` for headings, the site's greys (`#54595F`, `#7A7A7A`, `#A2A2A2`) for secondary and disabled text.
- **Borders and states:** light blue-grey borders, with gold `#AE874F` for hover, active and selected items.
- **Window title bars:** navy (`#202F3F`, `#131E2A` when active) with white titles.
- **Buttons:**
  - The Analyze button, step numbers and completed timeline steps use the site's bronze-to-gold button gradient.
  - The Analyzing state uses gold to light gold.
  - Other main buttons stay navy with light-gold text.
- **Graph nodes:** NBE teal `#1C6F8A`.
- Red and green status colours are unchanged.

The palette is documented in `nbe-daylight.css`, the theme list and Theme Studio defaults now use the new colours, and a backup of the old theme is saved in the session files.

**To see it:** hard-refresh. If you saved NBE Daylight overrides in Theme Studio, they will hide the new colours until you reset them.

The site also uses the Poppins font; I can add it if you want.

10962:/* ── Quick analysis panel: body structure ───────────────────────────── */
/* ── Quick analysis panel: body structure ───────────────────────────── */
.workspace_home_panel_body,
.workspace_home_panel_inputs {
	display: grid;
	gap: inherit;
	min-width: 0;
}

/* Expanded: fill the central workspace height in a single column. Flexible blocks
   (dropzone, file list, metric tiles) absorb the free space, so nothing is left
   blank and the panel itself never scrolls. */
.workspace_home_viewport_section > .workspace_home_panel.is-expanded {
	display: flex;
	flex-direction: column;
	height: 100%;
	overflow: hidden;
}

.workspace_home_panel.is-expanded > .workspace_home_panel_header {
	flex: none;
	margin-bottom: 0;
}

.workspace_home_panel.is-expanded > .workspace_home_panel_body,
.workspace_home_panel.is-expanded > .workspace_home_findings {
	flex: 1 1 auto;
	min-height: 0;
}

.workspace_home_panel_body.is-fill,
.workspace_home_panel_body.is-fill > .workspace_home_panel_inputs {
	display: flex;
	flex-direction: column;
	min-height: 0;
}

.workspace_home_panel_body.is-fill > .workspace_home_panel_inputs {
	flex: 1 1 auto;
}

.workspace_home_panel_body.is-fill .workspace_home_upload {
	flex: 1 1 auto;
	min-height: 64px;
	padding: 12px 18px;
	gap: 16px;
}

.workspace_home_panel_body.is-fill .workspace_home_file_list {
	flex: 0 1 auto;
	min-height: 40px;
}

.workspace_home_panel_body.is-fill .workspace_home_options,
.workspace_home_panel_body.is-fill .workspace_home_realtime_container,
.workspace_home_panel_body.is-fill > .workspace_home_review_section {
	flex: none;
}

.workspace_home_panel_body.is-fill .workspace_home_configs_grid {
	grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr));
	gap: 8px 18px;
}

/* Results: the panel hugs its content (compact) and is only capped at the
   workspace height. */
.workspace_home_viewport_section > .workspace_home_panel.is-expanded.is-results {
	height: auto;
	max-height: 100%;
}

.workspace_home_panel.is-expanded > .workspace_home_findings {
	gap: 12px;
	padding: 4px 0 0;
	overflow: hidden;
}

.workspace_home_panel.is-expanded > .workspace_home_findings > * {
	flex: none;
}

/* Very short screens: scrolling is the only way to keep everything reachable. */
@media (max-height: 640px) {
	.workspace_home_viewport_section > .workspace_home_panel.is-expanded {
		overflow-y: auto;
	}
}

/* Semi-transparent Full-Panel Cover Overlay */
.workspace_home_analysis_overlay {
	position: absolute;

	flex-direction: column;

import json,re,sys
r=json.load(open('/tmp/resolved.json'))
day=open('src/styles/themes/nbe-daylight.css').read()
# global daylight overrides (blocks with selector exactly [data-theme="nbe-daylight"])
for blk in re.findall(r'\n\[data-theme="nbe-daylight"\] \{([^}]*)\}',day):
    r.update(dict(re.findall(r'(--[\w-]+):\s*([^;]+);',blk)))
def res(v,d=0):
    if d>12: return v
    def rep(m):
        name=m.group(1); fb=m.group(2)
        if name in r: return res(r[name],d+1)
        return res(fb.strip(),d+1) if fb else 'UNDEF('+name+')'
    return re.sub(r'var\((--[\w-]+)(?:,\s*((?:[^()]|\([^()]*\))*))?\)',rep,v)

props=re.compile(r'^(color|background(-color)?|border(-[a-z]+)?(-color)?|box-shadow|outline(-color)?|fill|stroke|accent-color)$')
for m in re.finditer(r'([^{}]+)\{([^{}]*)\}',css):
    sel=' '.join(m.group(1).split())
    if not pat.search(sel) or sel.startswith('@'): continue
    if 'tooltip_anchor::' in sel: continue
    out=[]
    for d in m.group(2).split(';'):
        if ':' not in d: continue
        k,v=d.split(':',1);k=k.strip();v=v.strip().replace('!important','').strip()
        if props.match(k) and re.search(r'#|rgb|var\(|gradient|color-mix',v):
            out.append(f'   {k}: {res(v)[:110]}')
    if out: print(css.count('\n',0,m.start())+1, sel[:120]); print('\n'.join(out))
EOF

.workspace_zone_right {
	display: flex;
	align-items: stretch;
	justify-content: flex-end;
	position: relative;
	overflow: hidden;
	background-color: var(--right-workspace-bg-solid, #ffffff);
	background: var(--right-workspace-bg, linear-gradient(var(--right-workspace-gradient-angle, 180deg), var(--right-workspace-gradient-top, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.98)), var(--right-workspace-gradient-bottom, rgba(246, 239, 234, 0.98))));
	border-left: 1px solid var(--right-workspace-border, rgba(174, 135, 79, 0.35));
	border-radius: 6px;
	transition: width 280ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), background 280ms ease, background-color 280ms ease, border-color 280ms ease, opacity 350ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 350ms ease;
}

.workspace_zone_right.is-collapsed {
	position: relative !important;
	z-index: 200 !important;
	width: 48px !important;
	min-width: 48px !important;
	padding: 0 !important;
	border: 1px solid var(--right-collapsed-border, var(--linkx-launcher-border, rgba(174, 135, 79, 0.35))) !important;
	border-radius: 6px !important;
	color: var(--launcher-text, #131e2a) !important;
	transition: width 280ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), border-color 280ms ease;
	overflow: visible !important;
}

.workspace_context_panel {
	width: 100%;
	height: 100%;
	opacity: 1;
	pointer-events: auto;
	transition: opacity 180ms ease, transform 280ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1);
	transform: translateX(0);
}

.workspace_zone_right.is-collapsed .workspace_context_panel {
	opacity: 0 !important;
	pointer-events: none !important;
	transform: translateX(12px);
}

.workspace_right_collapsed_rail {
	position: absolute;
	right: 0;
	top: 0;
	bottom: 0;
	width: 48px;
	display: flex;
	flex-direction: column;
	align-items: center;
	justify-content: center;
	padding: 12px 6px;
	box-sizing: border-box;
	opacity: 0 !important;
	pointer-events: none !important;
	visibility: hidden !important;
	transition: opacity 180ms ease, transform 240ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), visibility 180ms ease;
	transform: translateX(6px);
	z-index: 10;
}

.workspace_zone_right.is-collapsed .workspace_right_collapsed_rail {
	opacity: 1 !important;
	pointer-events: auto !important;
	visibility: visible !important;
	transform: translateX(0);
}

.workspace_zone_right.is-collapsed.is-disabled .workspace_right_collapsed_rail {
	opacity: 0.7 !important;
}

.workspace_zone_right.is-disabled {
	opacity: var(--right-disabled-opacity, 0.45) !important;
	background: var(--right-disabled-bg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.03)) !important;
	border-color: var(--right-disabled-border, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12)) !important;
}

.workspace_zone_right.is-disabled .workspace_right_collapse_btn {
	pointer-events: auto;
}

.workspace_right_tabs_wrapper {
	transition: opacity 350ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 350ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
	transform: translateY(0);
}

.workspace_context_panel.is-disabled .workspace_right_tabs_wrapper {
	opacity: 0 !important;
	transform: translateY(-6px);
	pointer-events: none !important;
}

### Copilot

Mostly yes. The Settings styling feature (Theme Studio) writes your values directly onto the page root (`<html>`). Those beat the theme's base values, so most of your edits override the NBE Daytime colours. Your edits are saved per theme.

There are two exceptions, both from the NBE Daytime work, where your Studio changes will be ignored:

1. **Colour settings I set on specific areas instead of the page root.** A value set on an area beats your root-level edit for everything inside it.
   - **Left sidebar:** all the `--launcher-*` sidebar colours, the sidebar background/border and the logo disc.
   - **Right panel, collapsed:** the navy background and disabled colours (`--right-workspace-bg`, `--right-disabled-*`).
   - **Right panel header strip:** the disabled tab icon colour.
   - **Right panel text colours** (`--text-heading`, `--text-body`, etc.).
2. **Fixed colours** written directly into style rules, with no setting behind them:
   - the active tab's gold underline and gold icon
   - the context buttons (idle, hover, selected, danger)
   - the submit button's border and hover
   - the key-finding box
   - the disabled-notice icon background

Everything else in the right panel (tabs, cards, chat, forms, collapsed-rail buttons) uses theme-level colour settings, so your Studio edits will override it.

I can rework the exceptions so they read from settings at the page root. They'd then look the same but be fully editable in Studio. Want me to do that?

import React, { Suspense, lazy, memo } from 'react';

import { WORKSPACE_WINDOW_TYPES } from '../state/workspaceTypes.js';

const SourceWindowBody = lazy(() => import('../../features/source/components/SourceWindowBody.jsx'));
const SettingsWindowBody = lazy(() => import('../../features/settings/components/SettingsWindowBody.jsx'));

const bodyFallback = <div className="workspace_window_body" aria-busy="true" />;

// Header-only fields: editing them must not re-render the (heavy) window body.
const HEADER_ONLY_KEYS = new Set(['customTitle', 'updatedAt']);

const areBodyPropsEqual = (prev, next) => {
  const a = prev.windowItem;
  const b = next.windowItem;
  if (a === b) return true;
  const keys = new Set([...Object.keys(a), ...Object.keys(b)]);
  for (const key of keys) {
    if (!HEADER_ONLY_KEYS.has(key) && a[key] !== b[key]) return false;
  }
  return true;
};

function WorkspaceWindowBody({ windowItem }) {
  if (windowItem.type === WORKSPACE_WINDOW_TYPES.SOURCE) {
    return <Suspense fallback={bodyFallback}><SourceWindowBody windowItem={windowItem} /></Suspense>;
  }

  if (windowItem.type === WORKSPACE_WINDOW_TYPES.SETTINGS) {
    return <Suspense fallback={bodyFallback}><SettingsWindowBody windowItem={windowItem} /></Suspense>;
  }

  return (
    <div className="workspace_window_body">
      <p>{windowItem.title} workspace placeholder</p>
    </div>
  );
}

export default memo(WorkspaceWindowBody, areBodyPropsEqual);

 * VisualElementPicker — Inspector overlay.
 * When active, the user hovers over any element in the app to:

 *   2) See a floating tooltip listing ALL CSS variables affecting that element
 *   3) Click to "pin" the element and open an inline color editor panel
 *   4) Edit any CSS variable on the spot — changes are saved as custom overrides
 *
 * Press Escape or click the X to exit inspector mode.

          try { rules = sheet.cssRules || sheet.rules; } catch { continue; }
          if (!rules) continue;

          for (const rule of rules) {
            if (!rule.selectorText) continue;
            try {
              if (targetEl.matches(rule.selectorText)) {
                const ruleText = rule.cssText;
                const varMatches = ruleText.matchAll(/var\((--[\w-]+)/g);
                for (const m of varMatches) {
                  const varName = m[1];
                  if (!seen.has(varName)) {
                    seen.add(varName);
                    const val = computed.getPropertyValue(varName).trim() || rootStyle.getPropertyValue(varName).trim();
                    let propContext = 'unknown';
                    const escaped = varName.replace(/[-]/g, '\\-');
                    if (ruleText.match(new RegExp(`(?:background|background-color)\\s*:\\s*[^;]*var\\(${escaped}\\)`))) {
                      propContext = 'background';
                    } else if (ruleText.match(new RegExp(`(?:^|[^-])color\\s*:\\s*[^;]*var\\(${escaped}\\)`))) {
                      propContext = 'text color';
                    } else if (ruleText.match(new RegExp(`border[^:]*:\\s*[^;]*var\\(${escaped}\\)`))) {
                      propContext = 'border';
                    } else if (ruleText.match(new RegExp(`box-shadow\\s*:\\s*[^;]*var\\(${escaped}\\)`))) {
                      propContext = 'shadow';
                    } else if (ruleText.match(new RegExp(`accent-color\\s*:\\s*[^;]*var\\(${escaped}\\)`))) {

                    }

This is already in place: the window body has one border colour for inactive windows and a separate one for the active window.

- **Window Body Border (Active / Focused)** (`--window-body-border-active`) is used only on the focused window.

In NBE Daytime they default to light grey-blue (`#D5DEE8`) for inactive and gold (`#AE874F`) for active. The title bar has the same pair of settings, independent of the body.

To check it, hard-refresh, open two windows and click between them; the body border colour should switch.

  const storedPosition = windowItem?.metadata?.windowPosition;
  const storedX = Number(storedPosition?.x);
  const storedY = Number(storedPosition?.y);

  if (Number.isFinite(storedX) && Number.isFinite(storedY)) {
    return { x: storedX, y: storedY };

    x: DRAG_START_OFFSET.x + stackIndex * WINDOW_STAGGER.x,
    y: DRAG_START_OFFSET.y + stackIndex * WINDOW_STAGGER.y,

  const storedHeight = Number(storedSize?.height);
  const parentWidth = Number(parentSize.width) || 0;
  const parentHeight = Number(parentSize.height) || 0;
  const maxWidth = parentWidth > 0 ? Math.min(WINDOW_SIZE_LIMITS.maxWidth, Math.max(parentWidth - 44, WINDOW_SIZE_LIMITS.minWidth)) : WINDOW_SIZE_LIMITS.maxWidth;
  const maxHeight = parentHeight > 0 ? Math.min(WINDOW_SIZE_LIMITS.maxHeight, Math.max(parentHeight - 96, WINDOW_SIZE_LIMITS.minHeight)) : WINDOW_SIZE_LIMITS.maxHeight;

  return {
    width: clamp(Number.isFinite(storedWidth) ? storedWidth : DEFAULT_WINDOW_SIZE.width, WINDOW_SIZE_LIMITS.minWidth, maxWidth),
    height: clamp(Number.isFinite(storedHeight) ? storedHeight : DEFAULT_WINDOW_SIZE.height, WINDOW_SIZE_LIMITS.minHeight, maxHeight),
  };
};

*I'm looking at the windows code and see a conflict: a centering effect for the first window with no stored position runs after paint, while the initial-fit layout effect places it at the edge gap first, so the window visibly jumps. I'm also checking whether the centering effect re-runs on size changes, and I think the stored window position after a resize should prevent that, but the update goes through parent state, so I need to confirm the timing there.

I'm now looking at the resize observer on the canvas during the panel's width transition, which fires every frame and triggers a re-render for each window. I'm considering whether reading the observer's entry rect instead of calling getBoundingClientRect would lighten the load, and whether the shrinking during the animation needs attention.

Now I'm checking the drag handler: pressing the header toggles the dragging state even without movement, and each pointer move cancels and re-requests an animation frame, which is wasteful. I'd rather keep one pending frame and just update the latest value.

Next I'm checking how the drag-end persist reaches the parent and whether it triggers a workspace re-render or a synchronous storage write. I also want to look at the workspace layout CSS for the side-panel width transition, since animating width could be forcing a per-frame layout across the whole grid, which may be the main performance cost.*
