```
export default function WorkspaceFrame({ user, token, apiUrl, mainSessionId, sessionError, onSignOut, logoSrc }) {
  const displayName = user?.display_name || user?.username || user?.client_id || 'Analyst';
  const avatarLetter = displayName.trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase() || 'A';
  const launcherRef = React.useRef(null);
  const [isLauncherExpanded, setIsLauncherExpanded] = useState(false);
  const [isRightCollapsed, setIsRightCollapsed] = useState(false);
  const [sourceOpenError, setSourceOpenError] = useState('');
  const [isOpeningSource, setIsOpeningSource] = useState(false);
  const [isSidebarOverviewOpen, setIsSidebarOverviewOpen] = useState(false);
  const workspace = useWorkspace();


  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isLauncherExpanded) return undefined;

    const handleOutsidePointerDown = (event) => {
      if (launcherRef.current?.contains(event.target)) return;
      setIsLauncherExpanded(false);
      setIsSidebarOverviewOpen(false);
    };

    document.addEventListener('pointerdown', handleOutsidePointerDown, true);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('pointerdown', handleOutsidePointerDown, true);
  }, [isLauncherExpanded]);

  const collapseLauncher = () => {
    setIsLauncherExpanded(false);
    setIsSidebarOverviewOpen(false);
  };

  const windowsRef = React.useRef(workspace.windows);
  windowsRef.current = workspace.windows;
  const { closeWindow } = workspace;

  const handleCloseWindow = useCallback((windowId) => {
    const targetWindow = windowsRef.current.find((windowItem) => windowItem.id === windowId);
    if (targetWindow?.type === WORKSPACE_WINDOW_TYPES.SOURCE && token) {
      closeSourceWindow(apiUrl, token, {
        sessionId: targetWindow.parentSessionId,
        windowId: targetWindow.backendWindowId,
        reason: 'user_closed_window',
      }).catch((error) => {
        console.error('Source window cleanup failed', { status: error?.status, message: error?.message });
      });
    }
    closeWindow(windowId);
  }, [apiUrl, token, closeWindow]);

  const windowWorkspace = useMemo(() => ({
    ...workspace,
    closeWindow: handleCloseWindow,
  }), [workspace, handleCloseWindow]);

  const handleLauncherAction = async (item) => {
    setSourceOpenError('');
    collapseLauncher();

    if (item.windowType === WORKSPACE_WINDOW_TYPES.SOURCE) {
      if (!mainSessionId || !token) {
        setSourceOpenError('Session is not ready yet.');
        return;
      }

      const sourceWindowId = workspace.nextSourceWindowId;
      setIsOpeningSource(true);
      try {
        const identity = await initializeSourceWindow(apiUrl, token, {
          sessionId: mainSessionId,
          windowId: sourceWindowId,
        });
        workspace.openWindow(item.windowType, {
          contextTab: item.contextTab,
          title: item.label,
          backendWindowId: identity.windowId,
          parentSessionId: identity.parentSessionId,
          sourceSessionId: identity.sourceSessionId,
        });
        workspace.setContextTab(item.contextTab);
      } catch (error) {
        setSourceOpenError(error?.message || 'Source window could not be initialized.');
      } finally {
        setIsOpeningSource(false);
      }
      return;
    }

    workspace.openWindow(item.windowType, {
      contextTab: item.contextTab,
      title: item.label,
    });
    workspace.setContextTab(item.contextTab);
  };

  return (
    <main className="workspace_shell">
      <div className="workspace_background_overlay" aria-hidden="true" />
      <NetworkBackground />
      <div className={`workspace_frame${isLauncherExpanded ? ' is-launcher-expanded' : ''}`}>
        <aside ref={launcherRef} className="workspace_zone workspace_zone_left" aria-label="Workspace launcher">
          <nav className="workspace_launcher" aria-label="Workspace launcher">
            <div className="workspace_launcher_main">
              <button
                className="workspace_launcher_brand linkx_tooltip_anchor"
                type="button"
                aria-label={isLauncherExpanded ? 'Collapse launcher' : 'Expand launcher'}
                data-tooltip={isLauncherExpanded ? 'Collapse launcher' : 'Expand launcher'}
                aria-expanded={isLauncherExpanded}
                onClick={() => setIsLauncherExpanded((current) => !current)}
              >
                <img src={logoSrc} alt="Linkx logo" />
                <span className="workspace_launcher_brand_label">
                  <span>Linkx</span>
                  <small>Web analyzer</small>
                </span>
              </button>
              {launcherItems.map((item) => (
                <button
                  key={item.id}
                  className="workspace_launcher_button linkx_tooltip_anchor"
                  type="button"
                  data-tooltip={item.label}
                  aria-label={item.label}
                  disabled={Boolean(item.disabled || (item.windowType === WORKSPACE_WINDOW_TYPES.SOURCE && isOpeningSource))}
                  onClick={() => handleLauncherAction(item)}
                >
                  <LauncherIcon path={item.path} />
                  <span className="workspace_launcher_label">{item.label}</span>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
            <div className="workspace_launcher_bottom">
              {workspace.orientation === WORKSPACE_ORIENTATIONS.FLOATING && workspace.windows.length > 0 && (
                <div className="workspace_sidebar_overview_wrap">
                <button
                  className="workspace_launcher_button workspace_launcher_overview linkx_tooltip_anchor"
                  type="button"
                  data-tooltip="Show all windows"
                  aria-label="Show all open windows"
                  aria-expanded={isSidebarOverviewOpen}
                  onClick={() => setIsSidebarOverviewOpen((current) => !current)}
                >
                  <LauncherIcon path={overviewItem.path} />
                  <span className="workspace_launcher_label">Windows</span>
                </button>
                {isSidebarOverviewOpen && (
                  <div className="workspace_sidebar_overview_menu" role="menu" aria-label="Open windows overview">
                    {workspace.windows.map((windowItem) => (
                      <button
                        key={windowItem.id}
                        className={'workspace_sidebar_overview_item' + (workspace.activeWindowId === windowItem.id ? ' is-active' : '')}
                        type="button"
                        role="menuitem"
                        onClick={() => {
                          workspace.focusWindow(windowItem.id);
                          collapseLauncher();
                        }}
                      >
                        <LauncherIcon
                          className="workspace_sidebar_overview_icon"
                          path={windowIconPaths[windowItem.type] || overviewItem.path}
                        />
                        <span>
                          <strong>{windowItem.title}</strong>
                          <small>{windowItem.customTitle || 'Placeholder'}</small>
                        </span>
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
                </div>
              )}
              <button
                className="workspace_launcher_button workspace_launcher_orientation linkx_tooltip_anchor"
              type="button"
              data-tooltip={workspace.orientation === WORKSPACE_ORIENTATIONS.FLOATING ? 'Switch to docked tabs' : 'Switch to floating windows'}
              aria-label={workspace.orientation === WORKSPACE_ORIENTATIONS.FLOATING ? 'Switch to docked tabs' : 'Switch to floating windows'}
              aria-pressed={workspace.orientation === WORKSPACE_ORIENTATIONS.DOCKED}
              onClick={() => {
                workspace.toggleOrientation();
                collapseLauncher();
              }}
            >
              <LauncherIcon path={orientationItem.path} />
              <span className="workspace_launcher_label">
                {workspace.orientation === WORKSPACE_ORIENTATIONS.FLOATING ? 'Dock' : 'Float'}
              </span>
              </button>
              <button
                className="workspace_launcher_button workspace_launcher_signout linkx_tooltip_anchor"
              type="button"
              data-tooltip={signOutItem.label}
              aria-label={signOutItem.label}
              onClick={() => {
                collapseLauncher();
                onSignOut();
              }}
            >
                <LauncherIcon path={signOutItem.path} />
                <span className="workspace_launcher_label">{signOutItem.label}</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </nav>
        </aside>
        <div className={`workspace_work_area${isRightCollapsed ? ' is-right-collapsed' : ''}`}>
          <section className="workspace_canvas" aria-label="Workspace canvas">
            <div className="workspace_identity" aria-label="Current user">
              <span className="workspace_avatar" aria-hidden="true">{avatarLetter}</span>
              <span>{displayName}</span>
            </div>
            <WorkspaceHome
              openWindowsCount={workspace.windows.length}
              onOpenWindow={workspace.openWindow}
            />
            {(sessionError || sourceOpenError) && (
              <div className="workspace_session_notice" role="status">
                {sourceOpenError || sessionError}
              </div>
            )}
            <WindowManager workspace={windowWorkspace} />
          </section>
          <RightWorkspace
            displayName={displayName}
            workspace={workspace}
            logoSrc={logoSrc}
            isRightCollapsed={isRightCollapsed}
            onToggleCollapse={() => setIsRightCollapsed((current) => !current)}
          />
        </div>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}

export default function WindowManager({ workspace }) {
  if (workspace.windows.length === 0) return null;

  if (workspace.orientation === WORKSPACE_ORIENTATIONS.DOCKED) {
    return <WindowDock workspace={workspace} />;
  }

  return (
    <div className="workspace_window_manager" aria-label="Workspace windows">
      <div className="workspace_window_layer">
        {workspace.windows.map((windowItem, index) => (
          <WorkspaceWindow
            key={windowItem.id}
            windowItem={windowItem}
            stackIndex={index}
            isActive={workspace.activeWindowId === windowItem.id}
            onFocus={workspace.focusWindow}
            onCustomTitleChange={workspace.updateWindowCustomTitle}
            onWindowLayoutChange={workspace.updateWindowMetadata}
            onClose={workspace.closeWindow}
          />
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
```

<sub>1496m 15s</sub>

### Copilot

I made the window dragging and both panel animations smoother and more direct; all changes are in place. Lint and the theme check pass and the files load, but I couldn't test any of it in a browser.

**Window dragging and resizing**
- **First-window jump:** the first window used to be shown, then re-centred a moment later. It's now centred before it first appears.
- **Fight with the right panel:** that late centring re-ran whenever the window shrank, so it fought the automatic push-left when the right panel opened. It's gone.
- **Panel animation:** while the right panel opens or closes, every window used to re-render on every frame. Windows now move directly and save their final layout once the animation ends.
- **Clicks on the title bar:** a plain click no longer counts as a drag. A drag starts only after the pointer moves 3px.
- **Fast mouse movement:** each window now updates at most once per screen refresh, however many pointer events arrive.

**Right panel open/close**
- Its contents (chat, cards) keep a fixed width and slide out, instead of re-laying out on every frame of the animation.
- Once fully collapsed, the hidden panel is removed from drawing and clicks.
- It is now clipped while it slides out, so it doesn't ghost over the central workspace.

**Left sidebar**
- Opening or closing it no longer re-renders the whole right panel or the window layer.
- I removed a sidebar transition that never ran.

Hard-refresh, then try:
- dragging windows quickly
- opening and closing the right panel while windows are open
- clicking a window's title bar without moving the mouse

<sub>1556m 35s</sub>

### Copilot

The logs show it isn't crashing. Each time, something outside the CLI sent it a stop signal and it shut down cleanly (one log reads "Error shutting down MCP host on signal"; another shows it shutting down normally). It has restarted about 7 times since 08:23.

Likely causes, in order:

1. **The VS Code terminal or remote connection is dropping.** Your terminal runs over VS Code's remote connection. When that connection resets, VS Code closes the terminal and the CLI stops with it. The logs also show the CLI repeatedly losing and regaining its link to VS Code. Some attempts are rejected with "a connection for this session already exists", meaning another Copilot window is already connected to VS Code.
2. **The server is low on memory.** Only about 1.1 GB of 7.9 GB is free. Two `cloudcode_cli` processes use about 2 GB and 1.5 GB, and several Copilot instances are also running. Under that pressure the remote connection or terminal can get killed. I couldn't read the kernel log to confirm whether anything was killed for memory (that needs root).

What would help:
- **Close extra Copilot terminals.** They compete for the same VS Code link and memory.
- **Close the large `cloudcode_cli` processes if you don't need them.** I can do that if you tell me which ones are safe to stop.
- **Run the CLI inside `tmux`** (start `tmux`, then `copilot`). If the connection drops, you reconnect with `tmux attach` and the session is still there.
- **Pick up where you left off** with `copilot --resume`.
- **Get more detail next time** with `/collect-debug-logs`, or set `"logLevel": "all"` in `~/.copilot/settings.json`.

```
.workspace_window_dock {
	position: absolute;
	inset: 0;
	z-index: 3;
	display: grid;
	grid-template-rows: auto minmax(0, 1fr);
	/* padding: 64px 18px 18px; */
	pointer-events: auto;
	backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
}

.workspace_window_dock_header {
	position: relative;
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 42px;
	min-width: 0;
	background-color: var(--linkx-dock-header-bg);
}

.workspace_window_dock_tabs {
	display: flex;
	align-items: stretch;
	min-width: 0;
	overflow-x: auto;
	overflow-y: hidden;
	border: 1px solid rgb(41 53 56 / 43%);
	border-right: 0;
	border-bottom: none;
	backdrop-filter: none;
	scrollbar-width: none;
}

.workspace_window_dock_tabs::-webkit-scrollbar {
	display: none;
}

.workspace_window_overview_slot {
	position: relative;
	display: grid;
	border: 1px solid rgb(41 53 56 / 43%);
	border-bottom: 0;
	background: var(--linkx-dock-header-bg);
}

.workspace_window_overview_button {
	display: grid;
	place-items: center;
	border: 0;
	background: #324052;
	color: var(--dock-text-secondary);
	cursor: pointer;
}

.workspace_window_overview_button:hover,
.workspace_window_overview_button[aria-expanded="true"] {
	background: var(--dock-highlight);
	color: var(--dock-text);
}

.workspace_window_overview_button svg,
.workspace_window_overview_item svg {
	width: 20px;
	height: 20px;
	fill: none;
	stroke: currentColor;
	stroke-width: 1.8;
	stroke-linecap: round;
	stroke-linejoin: round;
}

.workspace_window_overview_menu {
	position: absolute;
	top: calc(100% + 6px);
	right: 0;
	z-index: 5;
	display: grid;
	gap: 3px;
	width: min(280px, 72vw);
	max-height: min(360px, calc(100dvh - 160px));
	overflow: auto;
	border: 1px solid var(--dock-border);
	border-radius: 4px;
	background: var(--dock-shell-bg);
	padding: 6px;
}

.workspace_window_overview_item {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: 22px minmax(0, 1fr);
	align-items: center;
	gap: 8px;
	width: 100%;
	border: 1px solid transparent;
	border-radius: 3px;
	background: transparent;
	color: var(--dock-text-secondary);
	padding: 8px;
	text-align: left;
	cursor: pointer;
}

.workspace_window_overview_item:hover,
.workspace_window_overview_item.is-active {
	border-color: var(--dock-card-bg);
	background: var(--dock-highlight);
	color: var(--dock-text);
}

.workspace_window_overview_item span {
	display: grid;
	gap: 2px;
	min-width: 0;
}

.workspace_window_overview_item strong,
.workspace_window_overview_item small {
	overflow: hidden;
	text-overflow: ellipsis;
	white-space: nowrap;
}

.workspace_window_overview_item strong {
	font-size: 12px;
	line-height: 1.25;
}

.workspace_window_overview_item small {
	color: var(--dock-text-muted);
	font-size: 10px;
	font-weight: 400;
	line-height: 1.25;
}

.workspace_window_dock_tab {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: minmax(136px, 210px) 30px;
	grid-template-rows: auto auto;
	min-width: 166px;
	border-right: 1px solid rgb(41 53 56 / 43%);
	border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(41 53 56 / 43%);
	background-color: var(--linkx-dock-tab-bg);
}
.workspace_window_dock_tab:hover {
	background-color: var(--linkx-dock-tab-bg);
}
.workspace_window_dock_tab.is-active {
	background: var(--dock-dock-active);
	border-bottom: none;
}
.workspace_window_dock_tab.is-dragging {
	opacity: var(--dock-dragging-opacity, 0.55);
}
.workspace_window_dock_tab.is-drop-target {
	background-color: var(--linkx-dock-tab-bg);
	box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 var(--dock-accent);
}
.workspace_window_dock_tab.is-active:hover {
	background: var(--dock-dock-active);
	cursor: default;
}
.workspace_window_dock_tab_focus {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: 18px minmax(0, 1fr);
	align-items: center;
	gap: 4px;
	min-width: 0;
	border: 0;
	background: transparent;
	color: var(--dock-text-secondary);
	padding: 8px 10px 1px;
	text-align: left;
	cursor: pointer;
}
.workspace_window_dock_tab.is-active .workspace_window_dock_tab_focus {
	cursor: default;
}
.workspace_window_dock_tab_icon {
	width: 20px;
	height: 20px;
	fill: none;
	stroke: currentColor;
	stroke-width: 1.8;
	stroke-linecap: round;
	stroke-linejoin: round;
	color: var(--dock-text-muted);
}
.workspace_window_dock_tab_focus span {
	overflow: hidden;
	text-overflow: ellipsis;
	white-space: nowrap;
	font-size: 12px;
	font-weight: 700;
	line-height: 1.25;
	color: var(--dock-text-secondary);
}
.workspace_window_dock_tab.is-active .workspace_window_dock_tab_focus span,
.workspace_window_dock_tab.is-active .workspace_window_dock_tab_icon {
	color: var(--dock-text);
}
.workspace_window_dock_tab_title_input {
	grid-column: 1;
	width: calc(100% - 35px);
	min-width: 0;
	border: 0;
	border-bottom: 1px solid transparent;
	border-radius: 0;
	background: transparent;
	color: var(--dock-text-subtle);
	margin: 0 10px 4px 35px;
	padding: 0 0 1px;
	font-size: 10px;
	font-weight: 400;
	line-height: 1.25;
	outline: none;
	text-overflow: ellipsis;
}
.workspace_window_dock_tab_title_input:hover,
.workspace_window_dock_tab_title_input:focus {
	border-bottom-color: var(--dock-accent);
	color: var(--dock-text-secondary);
}
.workspace_window_dock_tab_title_input::placeholder {
	color: var(--dock-text-subtle);
}
.workspace_window_dock_tab.is-active .workspace_window_dock_tab_title_input {
	color: var(--dock-text-secondary);
}
.workspace_window_dock_tab_close {
	grid-column: 2;
	grid-row: 1 / 3;
	display: grid;
	place-items: center;
	border: 0;
	background: transparent;
	color: var(--dock-text-muted);
	font-size: 16px;
	line-height: 1;
	cursor: pointer;
}

.workspace_window_dock_tab_close:hover {
	background: var(--dock-danger-bg);
	color: var(--dock-text);
}

.workspace_window_dock_tab.is-active .workspace_window_dock_tab_close {
	background: var(--dock-danger-bg);
}
.workspace_window_dock_tab.is-active .workspace_window_dock_tab_close:hover {
	background: var(--dock-danger-bg);
}
.workspace_window_dock_panel {
	display: grid;
	min-height: 0;
	border: 1px solid var(--dock-border);
	border-top: transparent;
	/* background: var(--dock-card-bg); */
	/* background: rgb(61 72 83 / 34%); */
	/* background: rgb(32 32 32 / 38%); */
	/* background: rgb(37 51 67); */
	box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 var(--dock-separator);
	overflow: hidden;
}
```

```
import React, { memo, useCallback, useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';

import WorkspaceWindowBody from './WorkspaceWindowBody.jsx';

const DRAG_START_OFFSET = {
  x: 22,
  y: 74,
};

const WINDOW_STAGGER = {
  x: 30,
  y: 24,
};

const DEFAULT_WINDOW_SIZE = {
  width: 1179,
  height: 823,
};

const WINDOW_SIZE_LIMITS = {
  minWidth: 640,
  minHeight: 420,
  maxWidth: 1800,
  maxHeight: 1200,
};

const RESIZE_DIRECTIONS = {
  LEFT: 'left',
  RIGHT: 'right',
  BOTTOM: 'bottom',
  BOTTOM_LEFT: 'bottom-left',
  BOTTOM_RIGHT: 'bottom-right',
};

const RESIZE_HANDLES = [
  { direction: RESIZE_DIRECTIONS.LEFT, className: 'is-left' },
  { direction: RESIZE_DIRECTIONS.RIGHT, className: 'is-right' },
  { direction: RESIZE_DIRECTIONS.BOTTOM, className: 'is-bottom' },
  { direction: RESIZE_DIRECTIONS.BOTTOM_LEFT, className: 'is-bottom-left' },
  { direction: RESIZE_DIRECTIONS.BOTTOM_RIGHT, className: 'is-bottom-right' },
];

const EDGE_GAP = 8;
const DRAG_THRESHOLD = 3;

const clamp = (value, min, max) => Math.min(Math.max(value, min), max);

const getInitialWindowPosition = (windowItem, stackIndex) => {
  const storedPosition = windowItem?.metadata?.windowPosition;
  const storedX = Number(storedPosition?.x);
  const storedY = Number(storedPosition?.y);

  if (Number.isFinite(storedX) && Number.isFinite(storedY)) {
    return { x: storedX, y: storedY };
  }

  return {
    x: DRAG_START_OFFSET.x + stackIndex * WINDOW_STAGGER.x,
    y: DRAG_START_OFFSET.y + stackIndex * WINDOW_STAGGER.y,
  };
};

const getInitialWindowSize = (windowItem, parentSize = {}) => {
  const storedSize = windowItem?.metadata?.windowSize || {};
  const storedWidth = Number(storedSize?.width);
  const storedHeight = Number(storedSize?.height);
  const parentWidth = Number(parentSize.width) || 0;
  const parentHeight = Number(parentSize.height) || 0;
  const maxWidth = parentWidth > 0 ? Math.min(WINDOW_SIZE_LIMITS.maxWidth, Math.max(parentWidth - 44, WINDOW_SIZE_LIMITS.minWidth)) : WINDOW_SIZE_LIMITS.maxWidth;
  const maxHeight = parentHeight > 0 ? Math.min(WINDOW_SIZE_LIMITS.maxHeight, Math.max(parentHeight - 96, WINDOW_SIZE_LIMITS.minHeight)) : WINDOW_SIZE_LIMITS.maxHeight;

  return {
    width: clamp(Number.isFinite(storedWidth) ? storedWidth : DEFAULT_WINDOW_SIZE.width, WINDOW_SIZE_LIMITS.minWidth, maxWidth),
    height: clamp(Number.isFinite(storedHeight) ? storedHeight : DEFAULT_WINDOW_SIZE.height, WINDOW_SIZE_LIMITS.minHeight, maxHeight),
  };
};

const applyFrameStyle = (element, nextPosition, nextSize) => {
  if (!element) return;
  element.style.transform = 'translate3d(' + nextPosition.x + 'px, ' + nextPosition.y + 'px, 0)';
  if (nextSize) {
    element.style.width = nextSize.width + 'px';
    element.style.height = nextSize.height + 'px';
  }
};

function WorkspaceWindow({ windowItem, stackIndex = 0, isActive, onFocus, onCustomTitleChange, onWindowLayoutChange, onClose }) {
  const windowRef = useRef(null);
  const dragRef = useRef(null);
  const resizeRef = useRef(null);
  const frameRef = useRef(null);
  const [isDragging, setIsDragging] = useState(false);
  const [isResizing, setIsResizing] = useState(false);
  const [position, setPosition] = useState(() => getInitialWindowPosition(windowItem, stackIndex));
  const [size, setSize] = useState(() => getInitialWindowSize(windowItem));
  // Refs hold the live geometry (updated during gestures and bounds changes
  // without re-rendering); state is committed afterwards to keep React in sync.
  const positionRef = useRef(position);

  const commitTimerRef = useRef(null);

  const commitLayout = useCallback((nextPosition, nextSize) => {
    if (nextPosition) {
      positionRef.current = nextPosition;
      setPosition(nextPosition);

      setSize(nextSize);

    pendingFrameRef.current = { nextPosition, nextSize };

  // Collapsed right panel → constrain to .workspace_canvas (don't cover tab rail)
  // Expanded right panel  → allow overflow into .workspace_work_area (panel is fully visible underneath)
  const getBoundsElement = useCallback(() => {
    const currentWindow = windowRef.current;
    if (!currentWindow) return null;
    const workArea = currentWindow.closest('.workspace_work_area');
    const isCollapsed = workArea?.classList.contains('is-right-collapsed');
    if (isCollapsed) {

    const maxHeight = Math.max(0, canvasRect.height - 2 * EDGE_GAP - offset * WINDOW_STAGGER.y);

    const rawX = dragState.originX + dx;
    const rawY = dragState.originY + dy;

    const nextPosition = bounds
      ? {
        x: clamp(rawX, 0, Math.max(0, bounds.maxRight - currentSize.width - 8)),
        y: clamp(rawY, 0, Math.max(0, bounds.maxBottom - currentSize.height - 8)),
      }
      : { x: Math.max(0, rawX), y: Math.max(0, rawY) };
```

### Reasoning

*I'm settling on how maximize should work: an isMaximized flag, with the window's bounds set to the workspace canvas rect so it doesn't cover the right panel. I'm also weighing whether to persist the flag in metadata so it survives a reload, and I'm leaning toward re-filling the canvas on resize while maximized.

I'm working out the maximize sizing: the window fills the canvas from 0,0 without the fit clamp shaving it down, and while maximized a resize re-fills the canvas instead. Restore goes back to the same centered default size used on mount. Dragging or resizing a maximized window just clears the flag and turns it back into a normal window.

I'm noting that position and size get persisted after the toggle, and I'm not sure whether persistLayout merges into metadata, so I'll leave the maximized flag out of persistence for now. The maximize icon is two diagonal arrows pointing outward, and when maximized it switches to the inward-pointing version. I also need to check the header's layout to see whether another button fits, and whether any button selectors elsewhere still need updating.

I'm checking the header's display rules and the tooltip CSS, since the header is where the new maximize button would go, and I want to confirm no other header button selectors need updating.*

```
import React from 'react';

import WindowDock from './WindowDock.jsx';
import WorkspaceWindow from './WorkspaceWindow.jsx';
import { WORKSPACE_ORIENTATIONS } from '../state/workspaceTypes.js';

function WindowManager({ workspace }) {
  if (workspace.windows.length === 0) return null;

  if (workspace.orientation === WORKSPACE_ORIENTATIONS.DOCKED) {
    return <WindowDock workspace={workspace} />;
  }

  return (
    <div className="workspace_window_manager" aria-label="Workspace windows">
      <div className="workspace_window_layer">
        {workspace.windows.map((windowItem, index) => (
          <WorkspaceWindow
            key={windowItem.id}
            windowItem={windowItem}
            stackIndex={index}
            isActive={workspace.activeWindowId === windowItem.id}
            onFocus={workspace.focusWindow}
            onCustomTitleChange={workspace.updateWindowCustomTitle}
            onWindowLayoutChange={workspace.updateWindowMetadata}
            onClose={workspace.closeWindow}
          />
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default React.memo(WindowManager);
```

*Right now the window stacking is driven by open order, so focused windows get a higher z-value but inactive ones fall back to their open-order position. That means when I focus one window and then another, the first can slide beneath windows it was previously on top of, which will be noticeable once there are many windows open.

I'm weighing two ways to fix the stacking: either move focused windows through a reducer-managed order, which would change props on every window and force broad re-renders, or keep a ref-based counter so only the newly activated window updates its own z-index. The ref approach looks cheaper, though I still need to check whether the window body component is memoized.

The next part is about whether the window layer creates its own stacking context, since that decides whether a global focus counter could push windows above overlays like menus or modals. I'm also noting that the mount stagger only uses the first few positions, so windows beyond that pile up on the same spot and become hard to see.

I'm working out the mount stagger next: the offset is capped at a few positions, so windows past that stack on the same spot. One option is to cycle the offset with the modulo of the stack index and shift each cycle sideways by a fixed amount, clamped to the canvas. The index is the window's position in the array at mount, so a window opened after others were closed just takes the last slot.

I'm now checking whether the window body is memoized and whether the window layer forms its own stacking context, since both affect how much re-rendering the focus change causes. I also want to confirm that the map in the window manager returns the same object for unchanged windows, which would keep the other windows from re-rendering.*

<sub>1893m 57s</sub>

### Reasoning

*I'm weighing whether an unbounded z-index counter is safe, since the manager's stacking context already caps things and the counter stays internal to each window. Reordering dock tabs changes stackIndex, which matters in floating mode, so I'd rather keep z-order on a focus counter that doesn't depend on stackIndex. Now I'm sketching the module-level counter and the ref to hold each window's z value.

Next I'm working out where the counter lives and when the z value gets set: on a layout effect when the window becomes active, writing straight to the DOM so nothing flashes before paint, and dropping the old stackIndex-based offset. A cache for bounds measurements is next on the list.

I'm settling the bounds cache: it would be keyed by the bounds element, so collapsed and expanded layouts stay separate, and since the max-right edge is measured against the same canvas for every window, one cached value works for all of them. The cache only applies on the resize and mount paths, while drag start still measures fresh. Restoring from saved metadata returns early, so the per-window mount measurement is cheap. Last, I'm making the stagger cycle after five windows.

Three problems show up with 10+ windows: stacking follows open order rather than click order, every window re-measures on each panel-animation frame, and placement stops staggering after six windows. Fixing all three now.*

<sub>1894m 49s</sub>

### Copilot

I rechecked the floating-window logic for 10+ windows open at once and fixed three problems, all in `WorkspaceWindow.jsx`. Lint passes with only the 2 warnings that were already there; I couldn't test with many windows in a browser, so please hard-refresh and try it.

1. **Stacking order:** a window's layer depended on the order it was opened, so clicking between windows could hide the one you'd just used. The window you click now comes to the front, and the others keep the order you last used them in. Only the window you click and the one losing focus redraw, so switching costs the same with 3 windows or 30.
2. **Panel animation lag:** while the right panel or sidebar animated, every window measured the workspace and forced a layout recalculation, once per window per frame. Windows now share one measurement per frame. Dragging and resizing still measure fresh.
3. **New window placement:** from the 7th window on, every new window opened in exactly the same spot. They now cascade in groups of 6, each group shifted further right and wrapping so new windows stay in view.

These already held up and didn't need changes: each window's content doesn't redraw when you move, focus or close another window, and dragging or resizing redraws only the window you're moving.

One remaining cost: every open window keeps its content loaded, so memory grows with each window. If that becomes a problem, inactive windows could pause their heavier content.

```
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useTheme } from './ThemeContext.jsx';

/**
 * VisualElementPicker — Inspector overlay.
 * When active, the user hovers over any element in the app to:
 *   1) See a cyan outline around the hovered element
 *   2) See a floating tooltip listing ALL CSS variables affecting that element
 *   3) Click to "pin" the element and open an inline color editor panel
 *   4) Edit any CSS variable on the spot — changes are saved as custom overrides
 *
 * Press Escape or click the X to exit inspector mode.
 */
const PICKER_LANDMARK_SELECTOR = [
  '.workspace_window',
  '.workspace_window_header',
  '.workspace_window_body',
  '[class*="workspace_zone_"]',
].join(', ');

export default function VisualElementPicker() {
  const { inspectorActive, toggleInspector, setCustomVariable, customOverrides } = useTheme();
  const [hoveredEl, setHoveredEl] = useState(null);
  const [pinnedEl, setPinnedEl] = useState(null);
  const [tooltipPos, setTooltipPos] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  const [pinnedVars, setPinnedVars] = useState([]);
  const [panelPos, setPanelPos] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 });

  // Extract CSS variables that affect a given DOM element (+ parents up to 6 levels)
  const extractCssVars = useCallback((el) => {
    if (!el) return [];
    const vars = [];
    const seen = new Set();
    const rootStyle = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement);

    // Scan an element's matching CSS rules for var(--xxx) references
    const scanElement = (targetEl, depth) => {
      const computed = getComputedStyle(targetEl);
      const tag = depth === 0 ? '(self)' : `(parent ×${depth})`;

      try {
        for (const sheet of document.styleSheets) {
          let rules;
          try { rules = sheet.cssRules || sheet.rules; } catch { continue; }
          if (!rules) continue;

          for (const rule of rules) {
            if (!rule.selectorText) continue;
            try {
              if (targetEl.matches(rule.selectorText)) {
                const ruleText = rule.cssText;
                const varMatches = ruleText.matchAll(/var\((--[\w-]+)/g);
                for (const m of varMatches) {
                  const varName = m[1];
                  if (!seen.has(varName)) {
                    seen.add(varName);
                    const val = computed.getPropertyValue(varName).trim() || rootStyle.getPropertyValue(varName).trim();
                    let propContext = 'unknown';
                    const escaped = varName.replace(/[-]/g, '\\-');
                    if (ruleText.match(new RegExp(`(?:background|background-color)\\s*:\\s*[^;]*var\\(${escaped}[,)]`))) {
                      propContext = 'background';
                    } else if (ruleText.match(new RegExp(`(?:^|[^-])color\\s*:\\s*[^;]*var\\(${escaped}[,)]`))) {
                      propContext = 'text color';
                    } else if (ruleText.match(new RegExp(`border[^:]*:\\s*[^;]*var\\(${escaped}[,)]`))) {
                      propContext = 'border';
                    } else if (ruleText.match(new RegExp(`box-shadow\\s*:\\s*[^;]*var\\(${escaped}[,)]`))) {
                      propContext = 'shadow';
                    } else if (ruleText.match(new RegExp(`accent-color\\s*:\\s*[^;]*var\\(${escaped}[,)]`))) {
                      propContext = 'accent';
                    }
                    vars.push({
                      name: varName,
                      value: val,
                      context: propContext,
                      selector: rule.selectorText,
                      source: depth === 0 ? 'direct' : `inherited ${tag}`,
                    });
                  }
                }
              }
            } catch { /* selector match can fail */ }
          }
        }
      } catch { /* cross-origin sheets */ }
    };

    // Scan self + parents (up to 6 levels), then keep climbing but only scan
    // container landmarks (window frame/header/body, workspace zones) so deeply
    // nested content still exposes its window's border/background variables.
    let current = el;
    for (let depth = 0; current && current !== document.documentElement; depth++) {
      if (depth < 6 || current.matches(PICKER_LANDMARK_SELECTOR)) scanElement(current, depth);
      current = current.parentElement;
    }

    // Also check inline styles
    const inlineStyle = el.getAttribute('style');
    if (inlineStyle) {
      const inlineVarMatches = inlineStyle.matchAll(/var\((--[\w-]+)/g);
      for (const m of inlineVarMatches) {
        const varName = m[1];
        if (!seen.has(varName)) {
          seen.add(varName);
          const val = getComputedStyle(el).getPropertyValue(varName).trim();
          vars.push({ name: varName, value: val, context: 'inline', selector: 'inline', source: 'direct' });
        }
      }
    }

    return vars.sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));

  }, []);

  // Hover handler
  const handleMouseMove = useCallback((e) => {
    if (!inspectorActive || pinnedEl) return;
    const el = document.elementFromPoint(e.clientX, e.clientY);
    // Ignore the inspector overlay and its children
    if (!el || el.closest('.element_picker_overlay') || el.closest('.element_picker_panel')) return;
    setHoveredEl(el);
    setTooltipPos({ x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY });
  }, [inspectorActive, pinnedEl]);

  // Click handler — pin element
  const handleClick = useCallback((e) => {
    if (!inspectorActive) return;
    // If clicking inside the panel, let it through
    if (e.target.closest('.element_picker_panel')) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();

    const el = document.elementFromPoint(e.clientX, e.clientY);
    if (!el || el.closest('.element_picker_overlay') || el.closest('.element_picker_panel')) return;

    const vars = extractCssVars(el);
    setPinnedEl(el);
    setPinnedVars(vars);
    setPanelPos({ x: Math.min(e.clientX + 12, window.innerWidth - 380), y: Math.min(e.clientY + 12, window.innerHeight - 400) });
  }, [inspectorActive, extractCssVars]);

  // Escape key to exit
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKey = (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        if (pinnedEl) {
          setPinnedEl(null);
          setPinnedVars([]);
        } else if (inspectorActive) {
          toggleInspector();
        }
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKey);
  }, [inspectorActive, pinnedEl, toggleInspector]);

  // Attach move + click listeners when inspector active
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!inspectorActive) {
      setHoveredEl(null);
      setPinnedEl(null);
      setPinnedVars([]);
      return;
    }
    document.documentElement.classList.add('is-element-picking');
    window.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove, true);
    window.addEventListener('click', handleClick, true);
    return () => {
      document.documentElement.classList.remove('is-element-picking');
      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove, true);
      window.removeEventListener('click', handleClick, true);
    };
  }, [inspectorActive, handleMouseMove, handleClick]);

  if (!inspectorActive) return null;

  // Hover outline box
  const hoverBox = hoveredEl && !pinnedEl ? (() => {
    const rect = hoveredEl.getBoundingClientRect();
    return {
      top: rect.top,
      left: rect.left,
      width: rect.width,
      height: rect.height,
    };
  })() : null;

  // Pinned outline box
  const pinBox = pinnedEl ? (() => {
    const rect = pinnedEl.getBoundingClientRect();
    return {
      top: rect.top,
      left: rect.left,
      width: rect.width,
      height: rect.height,
    };
  })() : null;

  // Tooltip content: element class + tag
  const hoverLabel = hoveredEl ? `${hoveredEl.tagName.toLowerCase()}${hoveredEl.className && typeof hoveredEl.className === 'string' ? '.' + hoveredEl.className.split(' ').filter(Boolean).slice(0, 2).join('.') : ''}` : '';
```

<sub>2041m 5s</sub>

### Reasoning

*I'm weighing a fallback for when `:not()` is invalid: if `matches` throws, I'd retry with the original selector part instead of skipping the rule entirely. I'm also noting that stripping `:disabled` means those rules will apply to enabled elements too, which is intended, while class-based states like `.is-active` aren't stripped, so their variables only show once the active tab is actually clicked.

I'm also checking the scrollbar selectors: the `_window_body` one only hits scrollable elements, which is good, and the global `::-webkit-scrollbar` falls back to `*` so scrollable elements pick up those variables too, which is fine. Next I'll add the fallback.*

```
import React, { Suspense, lazy, memo } from 'react';

import { WORKSPACE_WINDOW_TYPES } from '../state/workspaceTypes.js';

const SourceWindowBody = lazy(() => import('../../features/source/components/SourceWindowBody.jsx'));
const SettingsWindowBody = lazy(() => import('../../features/settings/components/SettingsWindowBody.jsx'));

const bodyFallback = <div className="workspace_window_body" aria-busy="true" />;

// Header-only fields: editing them must not re-render the (heavy) window body.
const HEADER_ONLY_KEYS = new Set(['customTitle', 'updatedAt']);

const areBodyPropsEqual = (prev, next) => {
  const a = prev.windowItem;
  const b = next.windowItem;
  if (a === b) return true;
  const keys = new Set([...Object.keys(a), ...Object.keys(b)]);
  for (const key of keys) {
    if (!HEADER_ONLY_KEYS.has(key) && a[key] !== b[key]) return false;
  }
  return true;
};

function WorkspaceWindowBody({ windowItem }) {
  if (windowItem.type === WORKSPACE_WINDOW_TYPES.SOURCE) {
    return <Suspense fallback={bodyFallback}><SourceWindowBody windowItem={windowItem} /></Suspense>;
  }

  if (windowItem.type === WORKSPACE_WINDOW_TYPES.SETTINGS) {
    return <Suspense fallback={bodyFallback}><SettingsWindowBody windowItem={windowItem} /></Suspense>;
  }

  return (
    <div className="workspace_window_body">
      <p>{windowItem.title} workspace placeholder</p>
    </div>
  );
}

export default memo(WorkspaceWindowBody, areBodyPropsEqual);
```

### Reasoning

*I'm checking how the two badges work right now: the tasks badge tracks running tasks, while the reports badge tracks completed reports, and the reports count never resets when opened. The user wants opening the Reports or Tasks window to clear both badges, so I'm weighing whether to lift the counters into WorkspaceFrame so they can be shared.

I'm settling on keeping a separate unseen count for each badge, so that clearing it on open doesn't disable the tasks option while tasks are still running. The unseen tasks count will never exceed the number of running tasks, and the reports count goes up whenever a report is ready.

I'm now checking whether the Tasks count should keep showing in the label, and I'm also deciding that the Reports option should stay disabled only when the total report count is zero. I'm also thinking that clearing the badge should happen whenever the Tasks window becomes the active one, including when it is focused from elsewhere, so a separate effect on the active window type would handle every path. That would let me drop the special-cased open handler, and I'm sketching a small ref and state setup in WorkspaceFrame to track the active window type.

Still writing the unseen-count handlers in WorkspaceFrame...

I'm checking how WorkspaceHome's options and the frame's window handling fit together, and whether activeWindowId behaves the same in floating and docked modes. I also want to see how the badge styles are defined in the CSS, so I know whether they use the design tokens.*
